**The Opportunity:**

As a project management specialist, you know the complexities of supporting a project from concept to completion. Many programs require a significant investment of limited resources, and it’s imperative to keep the project on a productive path. That’s why we need you, an experienced project management specialist who can help ensure success through careful analysis and effective communication.

  

  

As a member of the team, you will be tasked with providing Program Management support to an Assistant Program Manager (APM). jobs.title: Program Manager / Task Order Lead
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote (Washington, DC metro area preferred; occasional in\-person meetings at GSA Headquarters)


**Contract Type:** Full\-Time, Firm Fixed Price Task Order


**Clearance:** Active HSPD\-12 / Favorable Background Investigation Required


**Citizenship:** U.S. Citizenship Required


**Overview:**



Seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead a cross\-functional digital management support team for the General Services Administration (GSA) Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO). This role serves as the primary point of contact for the Contracting Officer (CO) and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), ensuring successful delivery across three task areas: Application and Enterprise Architecture, Financial Operations and FinOps, and AI and Data Governance.


**Responsibilities:**


* Provide overall program leadership, direction, and oversight for a 12\-month base \+ two 12\-month option period FFP task order.
* Manage day\-to\-day operations, staffing, and deliverables across all task areas.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the contractor team and GSA government personnel (CO, COR, and program office).
* Develop and maintain the Project Plan, including timeline, milestones, and quality processes.
* Facilitate the Kick\-off Meeting within 7 business days of award.
* Submit Monthly Status Reports by the 10th of each month, including progress, schedule, issues, corrective actions, and personnel status.
* Ensure all deliverables meet Federal accessibility standards (Section 508\) and GSA requirements.
* Lead agile project management and delivery methodologies.
* Coordinate cross\-functional integration, knowledge transfer, and best practice sharing across all task areas.
* Manage risk, resolve performance issues, and ensure contract compliance.
* Support key personnel substitution requests and ensure all personnel maintain required clearances.


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in IT, Business, or related field (Master's preferred).
* Minimum 10 years of experience managing federal IT programs, including FFP task orders.
* PMP or equivalent certification required.
* Demonstrated experience with agile project management and delivery.
* Experience managing multiple diverse projects from planning through execution.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Active HSPD\-12 clearance or favorable determination by contract award.


**Preferred:**


* Experience with GSA IT or similar federal agency.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams in a remote environment.
* Knowledge of GSA IT policies (CIO 2101\.1, CIO 2130\.2, CIO 2140\.4\).


**Schedule \& Work Conditions:**


* **Core Hours:** 9:00 AM \- 4:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday, excluding Federal holidays.
* **Work Location:** Primarily remote; occasional in\-person meetings at GSA Headquarters (Theodore Roosevelt Building, 1900 E Street NW, Washington, DC) as requested by the COR.
* **Travel:** Local travel within 50 miles of GSA sites in the Washington, DC metropolitan area is not reimbursable. No other travel is expected.
* **Telework:** Ad hoc or situational telework is authorized with prior approval from the Task Order Contracting Officer. Telework reports must be submitted by the end of each telework day.
* **Security:** Must maintain HSPD\-12 credential and favorable background investigation throughout the life of the task order.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager DoS CSS
jobs.description:
We are an employee\-centric company that truly values our team members and the contributions they make to our customers and the missions they support. We pride ourselves on being forward\-leaning thinkers and on building teams that are, and continue to be, technically proficient across a broad range of cyber mission areas. OneZero full\-time employees receive a highly competitive benefits package, including health, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 401(k) with company matching, paid time off and holidays, an employee referral program, and educational assistance. Additional details are available on our website: https://www.onezerollc.com/careers/

**Position Title**: Deputy Program Manager

**Location**: Remote; must reside within the National Capital Region (NCR).

**Clearance:** Secret

**Work Schedule:** Full\-time, 40 hours per week. Must be available during Department core hours of 9:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. ET, Monday – Friday, and flex working hours as needed to meet CST day\-to\-day and emergent requirements. No work is performed on Federal holidays or during Government closures.

**Employment Type**: Full\-Time, Exempt (W\-2\), contingent upon Call Order award


**Position Summary**


The Deputy Program Manager (DPM) is the secondary point of contact to the CO and COR and runs the day\-to\-day operations of the ISSO Support program. The DPM balances workload across the ISSO, engineering, and documentation teams supporting 70\+ consular systems, owns the deliverable production calendar and quality gate, leads transition\-in execution, and acts with full authority in the Program Manager's absence. This is a designated Key Personnel position under the Call Order.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as secondary point of contact for the CO and COR for all contractual, administrative, and performance matters; act for the Program Manager in his or her absence.
* Direct day\-to\-day operations: assign and balance ISSO portfolios, schedule and resource cybersecurity activities across teams, and ensure RMF activities align with ISSO oversight requirements.
* Own the deliverable calendar and quality gate for all recurringdeliverables: weeklySecurity Control Implementation Status, Issue Resolution, Remediation Status, and Risk Acceptance Recommendation reports; Quarterly Configuration and Change Impact Summaries; quarterly FISMA metrics.
* Lead execution of the Transition\-In Plan (staffing ramp\-up, knowledge acquisition, tool and system access, incumbent coordination) and develop the Transition\-Out Plan.
* Manage onboarding logistics with the FSO: Visitor Access Requests, badging, PIV issuance, OpenNet accounts, and mandatory FSI training tracking.
* Coordinate the program's response to audits, inspections, and data calls (OIG, GAO, CISA, HVA, BOD, OMB, CDM) within DT/EA/CST timelines.
* Supervise the Technical Writer and enforce the draft/final, 5\-day review, 10\-day incorporation, and zero\-defect formatting standards.
* Track program performance metrics, risks, and issues; prepare status reports, briefings, and meeting minutes for Government stakeholders.
* Manage ODC (travel and training) pre\-approval requests and documentation.
* Support recruiting, interviewing, and retention of cleared cybersecurity staff; mentor team leads.

**Required Qualifications**

* Eight (8\)\+ years of experience in cybersecurity program management (RFQ §M, Factor 2\).
* Demonstrated experience with Federal Government cybersecurity requirements (FISMA, NIST RMF, NIST SP 800\-53\).
* Current PMP or equivalent project management certification.
* Active, final SECRET security clearance; U.S. citizenship.
* Experience managing deliverable\-driven services contracts with recurring Government reporting.
* Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a related field.
* CISSP, CISM, CGRC/CAP, or CISA certification.
* Hands\-on ISSO or Assessment \& Authorization background.
* Prior Department of State (DT/CA/CST) experience; familiarity with ArchAngel and iPost.
* Experience on Firm\-Fixed\-Price and GSA MAS / HACS engagements.

**Technical Skills**

* NIST SP 800\-37 Rev. 2, SP 800\-53 Rev. 5, FISMA quarterly/annual metrics, OMB and CISA BOD requirements.
* Deliverable and workload management tooling (MS Project, Planner/Jira or equivalent, SharePoint, Excel).
* Working knowledge of GRC (ArchAngel, iPost) and scanning platforms (Tenable, Wiz) sufficient to direct and QA team outputs.
* Report production and executive briefing (Word, PowerPoint, Visio).

**Education**


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is required


Remote. Duties are performed remotely; the selected candidate must reside within the National Capital Region (NCR). The Government does not furnish equipment; OneZero provides the laptop and collaboration tools. Position requires an OpenNet account, DoS PIV badge, multifactor


OneZero Solutions LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

 **Position Summary**


The Program Manager (PM) leads OneZero Solutions' delivery of Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) Support to the Department of State's Bureau of Diplomatic Technology, Enterprise Applications, Consular Systems and Technology (DT/EA/CST) organization. The PM is the primary point of contact for the Contracting Officer (CO) and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) on all contractual, administrative, and performance matters, and is accountable for a team of 23 cleared cybersecurity professionals who keep more than 70 FISMA\-reportable consular systems authorized, compliant, and continuously monitored. This is a designated Key Personnel position under the Call Order; the individual must be available at time of award and committed for the full base period.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the CO, COR, and Government Technical Monitor (GTM) for all contractual, administrative, and performance matters; resolve issues and report program status.
* Provide overall leadership, resource planning, and coordination to ensure every PWS deliverable and timeline is met across the base and option periods.
* Plan and conduct the Post\-Award Kick\-Off Meeting within 5 business days of award, including delivery of the agenda, draft Transition\-In Plan, staffing plan, and draft Program Management Plan.
* Direct Transition\-In (Transition\-In Plan within 15 business days; staffing ramp\-up to full performance; knowledge acquisition; tool access) and Transition\-Out (plan 45 days before period end; artifact and knowledge turnover).
* Manage Firm\-Fixed\-Price performance: staff to full performance, maintain an adequate workforce to prevent interruptions, control cost and schedule, and manage pre\-approved ODCs.
* Own the deliverable quality system: draft/final cycles, 5\-business\-day Government review, 10\-business\-day comment incorporation, and a zero\-rejection standard for format, grammar, and conformance.
* Manage Key Personnel continuity and substitutions, including 15\-calendar\-day written notice and resume submission for CO approval(RFQ §L.C.5\).
* Recruit, hire, retain, and develop SECRET\-cleared cybersecurity staff; coordinate with the Facility Security Officer on Visitor Access Requests, badging, PIV issuance, OpenNet access, and mandatory training compliance.
* Maintain the program risk register; communicate risks, issues, and corrective actions to Government stakeholders; prepare monthly and quarterly program status reports and leadership briefings.
* Ensure compliance with Organizational Conflict of Interest disclosure, Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (C\-SCRM) requirements, and all DoS/CA/CST security policies(RFQ §H.1–H.3\).
* Champion CMMI\-aligned process discipline, quality assurance, and continuous improvement across the ISSO, engineering, and documentation teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Ten (10\)\+ years of experience managing large\-scale cybersecurity programs (RFQ §M, Factor 2\).
* Experience managing contracts of similar size, scope, and complexity, including Firm\-Fixed\-Price services.
* Demonstrated experience with Federal Government cybersecurity requirements (FISMA, NIST SP 800\-37 RMF, NIST SP 800\-53\).
* Current Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent project management certification.
* Active, final SECRET security clearance; U.S. citizenship.
* Available at the time of Call Order award and committed to the full base period of performance.
* Proven ability to recruit, hire, retain, and develop cleared cybersecurity personnel in the National Capital Region.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable briefing senior Government leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field.
* CISSP, CISM, or CGRC/CAP certification.
* Prior experience supporting the Department of State (DT, CA, or CST) or another federal civilian agency's ISSO / Assessment \& Authorization program.
* Experience managing GSA MAS / HACS SIN task or call orders.
* Experience leading programs supporting 50\+ FISMA systems.

About D\-BIR  

Dynamic Business Intelligence Resources, LLC (D\-BIR) is a Veteran\-Owned Small Business specializing in mission\-driven digital and systems transformation for Federal Government customers. We help organizations integrate data, improve business processes, modernize information environments, and turn complex operational data into trusted information for decision\-making.  

D\-BIR is seeking an experienced **Senior Data Analyst (Data Integration \& Quality Lead)** to support an anticipated Department of War Education Activity (DoWEA) facilities program. This is not solely a dashboard\-development position. We are looking for a senior analyst who is equally comfortable working with databases, data quality, business processes, system documentation, Government stakeholders, and technical teams.  

Position Overview  

The Senior Data Analyst will support the development and execution of an integrated data management and quality approach connecting facility assessments, real property information, facility utilization data, asset records, technical documentation, and Government systems of record.  

The successful candidate will help establish and maintain the data structures, validation controls, crosswalks, documentation, reconciliation processes, and quality\-management practices needed to ensure that information remains accurate, complete, traceable, consistent, secure, and usable throughout the program lifecycle.  

The position requires an individual who can work independently at a senior level while collaborating closely with program managers, facility professionals, engineers, inspectors, Government stakeholders, and other technical subject matter experts.  

Key Responsibilities  

The Senior Data Analyst will:  

* Lead or support data integration, data quality, reconciliation, and technical data\-management activities across multiple facility\-related datasets and Government systems.
* Develop and maintain data dictionaries, schema documentation, data models, field definitions, business rules, reference data, and source\-to\-target mappings.
* Establish and maintain master facility, building, asset, and real property crosswalks across disparate data sources and identifiers.
* Perform complex data profiling, cleansing, transformation, reconciliation, and validation to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, incomplete, or conflicting records.

* Track data discrepancies from identification through analysis, Government decision, system update, verification, and closure.

* Work with facility condition, utilization, real property, environmental, and other technical teams to ensure field\-generated information is properly associated with the correct facility, asset, component, space, or record.

* Support Real Property Inventory reconciliation, including facility identifiers, RPUIDs, facility numbers, ownership, status, square footage, geolocation, and related attributes.
* Develop and maintain documentation describing datasets, schemas, analytical pipelines, collection methodologies, databases, interfaces, dependencies, transformations, and operating processes.
* Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), user guides, process documentation, workflow diagrams, architecture diagrams, and technical reference materials.
* Maintain data lineage, version history, change\-control records, decision logs, discrepancy registers, and other auditable technical records.
* Support database and data\-pipeline operations, controlled imports and exports, data transformations, and recurring data\-processing activities.
* Develop Power BI reports, dashboards, metrics, and other analytical products to communicate data quality, reconciliation status, operational performance, exceptions, and program risk.
* Use Microsoft Power Platform capabilities, including Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, and SharePoint, to support authorized workflow automation, tracking, reporting, and information\-management solutions.
* Develop queries and analytical processes using SQL and other appropriate data tools.
* Work with program leadership to define data\-quality metrics, KPIs, performance measures, quality gates, and reporting requirements.
* Support quality\-control reviews prior to release of datasets, documentation, system updates, and analytical deliverables.
* Support Government comment resolution, corrective actions, root\-cause analysis, and validation of corrected deliverables.
* Support audit readiness by maintaining traceability between source records, transformations, approvals, system updates, and final deliverables.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.  

  

Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. That makes it hard for teams to bring it together, and hard for AI to do anything with it. You'll connect those sources, structure them so AI can actually retrieve and reason over the content, and design tools on top of them. The teams who produce the data still own it. You make sure it's structured, accessible, and fits together, so everyone gets more out of it.  

  

A lot of this job comes down to giving people across the team more ownership of their work. That happens two ways. First, by reducing dependencies, the places where people are stuck waiting on a manual step, a handoff, or the one person who knows how something works. Second, by clearing away the rote, repetitive work that fills their days. You'll get to know how GCC operates, find where both of these slow people down, and build what it takes to help. Everyone here is a builder, and your job is to support that.  

  

No two months in this role look the same. The data keeps growing, the tools keep changing, and there's always a new challenge worth taking on. It's a great fit for someone who likes to work independently, dig into complex problems, and see their work make a difference across a team.

The Program Manager must pair deep expertise in large\-scale shipbuilding and rate production with an instinct for modular kits, payloads, and mission\-package integration—understanding how a common hull is configured, re\-configured, and sustained to meet diverse customer needs. This role owns the balance between production throughput and mission flexibility.


The Program Manager serves as the primary customer\-facing relationship owner. Partnering closely with the internal Saronic growth, engineering, production and quality teams, the right candidate brings the customer fluency to manage government stakeholders and contracts. The PM should also have the acumen to make technical decisions aligned to the customer needs and contract requirements, and the programmatic discipline to deliver a large, complex platform at scale.

**Kit \& Mission Package Integration**

* Balance production standardization against mission\-driven variance, protecting throughput while enabling flexibility.
* Ensure integration timelines, dependencies, and configuration baselines are reflected in the master program plan.

**Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**

jobs.description:
Overview:

LMI is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the delivery of LMI's technology portfolio supporting the United States Postal Service (USPS). USPS operates the nation's largest delivery and logistics network and is in the midst of a multi\-year modernization effort to improve service reliability, transform the customer experience, and achieve long\-term financial sustainability. The TPM will be LMI's senior technical leader on this account: owning the end\-to\-end deployment of technology solutions into the USPS environment and serving as the trusted advisor who connects hands\-on engineering execution to USPS mission and business outcomes.


This is a hands\-on leadership role for a professional who can lead the deployment of a diverse portfolio of enterprise technologies into a large, complex federal environment, including ServiceNow, the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure), AI\-enabled and agentic solutions, custom software applications, AI\-assisted software engineering approaches, and commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) products. The TPM manages a portfolio of concurrent technology projects and deployments, sets and enforces best practices across software development, customer/user experience (CX/UX) design, security, and release management, and is personally accountable for the cost, schedule, quality, and adoption of every solution the team delivers. Equally important to the technical mandate is customer management and relationship building. The TPM builds and sustains strong working relationships with USPS stakeholders, translating their needs into actionable solution roadmaps, communicating clearly across both technical and non\-technical audiences, driving consensus, and continuously demonstrating value. The role demands someone who thrives in an environment that emphasizes building, deploying, and iterating in parallel, and who can own the full solution lifecycle alongside the client.

**Role Scope \& Authority**


This senior leadership role reports to the LMI USPS Account Lead and serves as LMI’s primary technical leader on the account. The position oversees a portfolio of multiple concurrent technology initiatives and leads a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, designers, analysts, and subcontractors.


The TPM has broad authority to set delivery standards, prioritize and sequence work, approve technical approaches, escalate risks to USPS and LMI leadership, and recommend staffing and resource decisions. The role interacts regularly with USPS senior IT and business stakeholders at the director and executive levels.

**About LMI**


LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial\-grade platforms and mission\-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.  

Leveraging our mission\-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.  


Responsibilities:
* **Portfolio Delivery \& Execution**:
	+ Serve as LMI's senior technical lead and primary technical point of contact for the USPS account.
	+ On\-time, on\-budget delivery of technology solutions into the USPS production environment across multiple platforms and technologies.
	+ Build and sustain trusted relationships with USPS stakeholders, acting as the senior advisor on solution approach and continuously identifying opportunities to add value and expand impact.
	+ Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of technology deployments into the USPS environment (e.g., intake, solution design, build, integration, test, deployment, and sustainment)
	+ Prioritize, sequence, balance workload, and allocate resources to effectively manage and deconflict a portfolio of concurrent technology projects and deployments

In this role, you’ll work in a SAFe Agile environment to coordinate planning, backlog and dependency management, release activities, risks, issues, and delivery commitments. You’ll help establish a steady delivery rhythm while ensuring teams have the clarity, resources, and support needed to make meaningful progress.

  

You’ll work with technical teams, customer stakeholders, vendors, and leadership to communicate progress, resolve obstacles, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle. You’ll also support testing, implementation readiness, cutover, stabilization, and transition to operations. jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Global Workplace Services (GWS) plans, delivers, and operates Microsoft's global real estate portfolio of approximately 40 million square feet (SF) across an outsourced, multi\-region delivery model. This role provides the global operating backbone for Transaction Management and portfolio planning by establishing consistent frameworks, governance, analytics, and decision tools that improve visibility, strengthen controls, and enable more timely, data\-informed real estate decisions.


As that portfolio grows more dynamic, GWS needs consistent, well\-governed frameworks for how transactions are planned and executed and how portfolio strategy is shaped by data.


The Senior Program Manager will be responsible for creating the methodologies supporting portfolio scenario planning, demand planning, and transaction analytics. The role will translate regional and business requirements into scalable standards, tools, and operating practices. Regional leadership and the GWS leadership team retain accountability for regional and global portfolio strategy and transaction decisions.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is excited to continue our support for the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


The F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) is a joint, multi\-national program and is the Department of Defense’s (DoD) focal point for defining affordable next generation strike aircraft weapon systems among the United States (U.S.) Air Force (USAF), U.S. Navy (USN), U.S. Marine Corps (USMC), and U.S. allies currently composed of seven (7\) cooperative international partners: the United Kingdom, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Denmark, and Norway; as well as Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The F\-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting\-edge technologies to the battle\-space of the future. The F\-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F\-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product\-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems \& Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.


Our **Senior Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst**, located at Crystal City, VA, supports the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) International Directorate (ID), Foreign Military Sales (FMS), in in acting as the focal point for all F\-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F\-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F\-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the FMS USG Program Managers who represent the FMS Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant FMS nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program.


You will be part of a dynamic team of F\-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who work closely with the customer and other key F\-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F\-35 systems.


In this role you will:


* International Integration and support – assist ID in facilitating the programs of two types of countries associated with the F\-35 program: “Partners” (also referred to as “Participant”), –who are signatories to the JSF Production, Sustainment and Follow\-on Development Memorandum of Understanding (JSF PSFD MOU), and “FMS Customers,” which have a signed Letters of Requests (LORs) and Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs) for purchasing aircraft, related material, and services.
* International Programs –
	+ Assist ID in supporting National Deputies and their assistants in representing each of the F\-35 Partner nations resident in ID.
	+ Assist ID in supporting Service Deputies and their assistants in representing each of the F\-35 US Services resident in ID.
	+ Assist the USG Program Manager (PM) in representing each FMS customer and managing the F\-35 LOA that is the foundation of each FMS country’s F\-35 program.
	+ Assist FMS PMs, Service Deputies and USG Partner country managers in leading USG activities and Program Management Reviews (PMRs) for each country in the F\-35 Program to ensure each program remains on track.

jobs.title: GTM Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**


Healthcare quality is complex. Medisolv helps make it manageable — and actionable.


We partner with hospitals, health systems, ACOs, and payers to bring clarity to quality data, connecting clinical and claims information into a single, reliable view. More than 1,800 organizations and 130M\+ patient records rely on Medisolv to measure, report, and improve performance across 500\+ measures tied to CMS, The Joint Commission, and other programs.


With support from Bessemer Venture Partners Forge, we're continuing to grow our platform and expand our impact — investing in advanced analytics, AI, and new capabilities that help healthcare organizations stay ahead of change and improve outcomes with confidence.


Reporting to the GTM Operations Manager, we are looking for a GTM Operations Analyst to join our team.

**About the Role**


The GTM Operations Analyst is the tactical backbone of Medisolv's go\-to\-market engine. You'll manage the day\-to\-day execution, data integrity, and reporting that keep Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Services running smoothly — from HubSpot administration and CRM hygiene to dashboarding and lifecycle reporting.


This role sits close to the systems and the data. You will maintain workflows and automations, keep the CRM clean and trustworthy, and build the dashboards and reports that give GTM teams visibility into pipeline health and performance. You'll partner closely with the GTM Operations Manager, translating day\-to\-day operational work into the visibility and process improvements the broader team relies on.


As Medisolv continues to grow, you'll have the chance to build real depth across HubSpot and the wider GTM tech stack — and to grow into broader Revenue Operations responsibility over time.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day\-to\-day HubSpot administration, including user setup, permissions, workflows, and automation updates across Sales, Marketing, and Service Hubs
* Maintain CRM data hygiene through deduplication, standardization, and ongoing quality checks
* Build and maintain dashboards, lists, and reports that give GTM teams visibility into pipeline health, deal velocity, and conversion across the lead\-to\-customer lifecycle
* Support campaign tracking, lead routing, and lifecycle process execution
* Assist with day\-to\-day support of GTM system integrations, including HubSpot, Gong, ZoomInfo, and Definitive
* Support quoting, contracting, and deal desk workflows, helping ensure deals move smoothly through approvals prior to close
* Document GTM processes and provide end\-user support and training across Sales, Marketing, and Service teams
* Partner with the GTM Operations Manager on analytics, pipeline reporting, forecasting support, and process improvement initiatives

**What You'll Accomplish — Your Performance Objectives**

**In your first 30 days, you will:**


Onboard and get to know the people, products, and departments that make Medisolv run. You'll build immersion in HubSpot, the GTM tech stack, and the lead\-to\-customer lifecycle, and begin shadowing existing workflows and reporting.

**In your first 60 days, you will:**


Begin independently managing day\-to\-day HubSpot administration, data hygiene checks, and recurring reporting, with support from the GTM Operations Manager as you take on more ownership.

**In your first 90 days, you will:**


Fully own your recurring GTM reporting, dashboards, and HubSpot administration responsibilities — contributing process documentation and partnering closely with the GTM Operations Manager on pipeline visibility and improvement initiatives.

**Who We're Looking For — The Competencies That Matter**

**Required**

* 5 plus years of experience in marketing operations, sales operations, revenue operations, or CRM administration
* Familiarity with HubSpot (preferred) or comparable CRM/marketing automation tools
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy
* Basic reporting and analytics skills in HubSpot, Excel, or Google Sheets
* Strong bias for action, with the initiative to drive tasks from inception to completion
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally and build relationships, even when priorities or personalities compete
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to dissect problems and tell a clear story using data
* Eagerness to learn Revenue Operations concepts and grow within the function

**Preferred**

* Exposure to complementary GTM tools such as Gong, ZoomInfo, or Definitive
* Experience supporting deal desk, quoting, or contracting workflows
* A track record of spotting and implementing process or automation improvements
* Prior experience in a SaaS or B2B environment

**How to Be a Medisolver — Our Values**

* Customer Success Obsession
* All\-Star Team Collaboration
* Continuous Improvement through Curiosity \& Data\-Driven Learning
* Courage with Kindness
* Execution Focus — We Do Business, Not Just Talk Business

 *Medisolv is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that diversity drives innovation, and we are dedicated to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued and respected.*

*All candidates must successfully pass a pre\-employment background check and be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship is not available.*

The Deputy CPM will assist the Contractor Program Manager with the day\-to\-day management and execution of the IMUA program, including contract performance, financial oversight, staffing, reporting, schedules, training, security deliverables, quality control, and contract administration.


The Deputy CPM will coordinate across MDW, subcontractor personnel, and Government stakeholders to ensure program information is accurate, contract deliverables are completed on time, and performance risks are identified and addressed. The individual will also provide continuity of program leadership and may perform CPM responsibilities when delegated by the Contractor Program Manager.

*This is a hybrid position requiring some on\-site presence.*


The **Deputy Contractor Program Manager** may perform a combination of some or all of the following duties:

* Support the Contractor Program Manager in overseeing contract and subcontractor performance across all program locations and functional areas.
* Coordinate regularly with Government program managers, the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), task leads, corporate leadership, and subcontractor representatives.
* Prepare and consolidate financial, staffing, performance, risk, and program status information for recurring reports, reviews, and Government meetings.
* Monitor contract expenditures, labor utilization, funding, burn rates, cost variances, and Estimated Cost at Completion (EAC) projections.
* Maintain the program reporting calendar and deliverable tracker to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant submission of contract data requirements list (CDRL) deliverables.
* Coordinate inputs for monthly status reports, financial reports, staffing reports, program management reviews, and other contractually required deliverables.
* Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of the Program Management Plan (PMP), Quality Control Plan (QCP), transition plans, staffing plans, risk register, and associated management procedures.

* Assist with workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, retention, personnel assignments, vacancy management, and employee performance matters.
* Monitor completion of required eNomination actions, non\-disclosure agreements, training, security documentation, and other personnel onboarding requirements.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and functional leads to collect program data, evaluate performance, address staffing or performance concerns, and maintain consistent execution across the team.
* Support contract transition\-in and transition\-out activities to maintain continuity of operations and minimize disruption to the NGA mission.
* Assist with the preparation and coordination of documentation supporting funding actions, contract modifications, staffing changes, and other contract administration activities.
* Review reports, presentations, spreadsheets, and other deliverables for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance with contract requirements.

* Experience supporting or implementing Program Management Plans, Quality Control Plans, transition plans, risk\-management processes, and corrective\-action procedures.
* Experience managing staffing activities, including recruiting, onboarding, personnel tracking, vacancy management, retention, and performance monitoring.
* Ability to organize and manage multiple concurrent deadlines, deliverables, meetings, and action items in a complex contract environment.
* Proven ability to identify performance risks, develop practical mitigation strategies, and follow issues through resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with Government program managers, CORs, contracting personnel, corporate leadership, employees, and subcontractors.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat for preparing reports, presentations, spreadsheets, and contract documentation.

**Desired Experience/Skills:**

* Experience supporting programs within NGA, the Department of War, the Intelligence Community, or another Federal Government organization.
* Experience serving as a Deputy Program Manager, Operations Manager, Contract Manager, or senior program\-management analyst on a contract of similar size, scope, and complexity.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or comparable program\-management certification.
* Experience supporting large professional\-services contracts with personnel working across multiple Government and contractor locations.

jobs.description:

**Position Title**: Senior Information Security Analyst

**Location:** Remote; must reside within the National Capital Region (NCR).

**Clearance**: Secret

**Work Schedule:** Full\-time, 40 hours per week. Must be available during Department core hours of 9:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. ET, Monday – Friday, and flex working hours as needed to meet CST day\-to\-day and emergent requirements. No work is performed on Federal holidays or during Government closures.

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt (W\-2\), contingent upon Call Order award

 **Position Summary**


The Senior Information Security Analyst serves as ISSO of record for an assigned portfolio of approximately 6–8 Moderate\-baseline consular systems. The Senior Analyst owns each system's authorization package and continuous monitoring cadence end to end, leads the system's triennial RMF cycle, directs technical remediation by system operations teams, and provides day\-to\-day direction to Information Assurance Analysts supporting the portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as ISSO of record and primary cybersecurity point of contact for an assigned portfolio of approximately 6–8 Moderate\-baseline systems.
* Execute RMF Steps 1–3 for assigned systems: categorization with CIA justification, baseline and overlay selection, tailoring rationale, Inherited Controls Matrix, SSP and Security Control Implementation Statements, Evidence Index, and Implementation Readiness Review.
* Develop and maintain PIA, DIRA, ISA/MOU, Security Assessment Plan, POA\&M, SIA, system inventory, IRP, CP/ISCP, CP Test report, and CMP for assigned systems; ensure CMPs are delivered into the GRC tool.
* Set up and support Security Control Review Meetings and demos, collect and validate artifacts requested by the SCA, attend A\&A Findings Meetings, and support remediation validation(RMF Step 4\).
* Maintain authoritative POA\&Ms in theGRC tool (monthlyupdates and within 5 business days of status changes) with realistic milestones, accurate risk levels, and closure evidence attached (RMF Step 6\).
* Review iPost scores weekly; coordinate remediation with system and application teams; track and report findings open more than 30 days.
* Review vulnerability, KEV, CVE, and STIG results within 5 business days; drive critical and high remediation within Department and BOD timelines; document in POA\&Ms.
* Conduct annual Contingency Plan tests and Annual Control Assessments; document results and lessons learned; update CP, ISCP, IRP, and CMP as needed.
* Perform Security Impact Analyses for hardware, software, patch, and configuration changes; participate in CCB/ECM; contribute to the Quarterly Configuration and Change Impact Summary.
* Coordinate incident reporting and documentation with the SOC and system owners; reflect outcomes in risk posture and POA\&Ms.
* Direct system\-specific security operations contractors to obtain evidence and implement remediation; validate completion before POA\&M closure.
* Support audits and data calls (OIG, GAO, CISA, HVA, BOD, OMB, CDM) and maintain the Audit and Data Call Response Package for assigned systems.
* Provide day\-to\-day direction and quality review for Information Assurance Analysts supporting the portfolio.

**Required Qualifications**

* Seven (7\)\+ years of information security experience, including four (4\)\+ years as an ISSO or in an equivalent A\&A role for federal information systems.
* Demonstrated experience authoring SSPs, POA\&Ms, contingency plans, and supporting authorization packages under NIST SP 800\-37 / SP 800\-53 Rev. 5\.
* One of: CISSP, CISM, CGRC/CAP, or CISA (DoD 8140/8570 IAM Level II or higher).
* Active, final SECRET security clearance; U.S. citizenship.
* Experience with an enterprise GRC tool and with interpreting vulnerability scan results.
* Strong technical writing and stakeholder coordination skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Department of State (DT/CA/CST) experience; ArchAngel and iPost proficiency.
* Experience with cloud or hybrid authorization boundaries and FedRAMP inheritance.
* Experience conducting NIST SP 800\-34 contingency plan tests and NIST SP 800\-63 Digital Identity Risk Assessments.
* Security\+ CE, CySA\+, or CCSP in addition to the required certification.

**Technical Skills**

* NIST SP 800\-37 Rev. 2, 800\-53/53A Rev. 5, 800\-60, 800\-34, 800\-61, FIPS 199/200; CISA BODs and KEV.
* GRC platforms (ArchAngel or equivalent), iPost or equivalent, POA\&M lifecycle management.
* Reading Tenable/Nessus, Wiz, and STIG output; understanding of patch and configuration management.
* Visio diagramming; advanced Word/Excel; SharePoint/Teams collaboration.

**Security Clearance**


Active, final SECRET

**Education**


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an additional four (4\) years of directly relevant experience in lieu of degree.

**Remote/Hybrid/On\-site and any other relevant work\-environment requirement**


Remote. Duties are performed remotely; the selected candidate must reside within the National Capital Region (NCR). jobs.title: Tech Infra Program Manager, Non-Standard Infrastructure Delivery (NSID)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

About the Role  

The AWS Non\-Standard Infrastructure Global Delivery Team builds and scales infrastructure for AWS programs that don't fit neatly into traditional data center models. Our projects are tailored to the specific needs of internal and external customers — from satellite ground stations that downlink data from orbit, to specialized labs where engineers develop custom silicon and push the boundaries of quantum computing, to purpose\-built environments with precision environmental controls for archival storage systems, to infrastructure that extends the AWS network to the furthest edge of its global footprint. Each program brings its own constraints, its own technical requirements, and often its own first\-of\-kind design challenges.  

What makes this team unique is the degree of ambiguity we operate in. Many of our projects begin as loosely defined requests from internal customer teams who know what they need to accomplish but not necessarily what infrastructure it takes to get there. A significant part of this role is working upstream with those customers to develop initial requirements, define technical scope, build demand forecasts, and refine scaling models — often for infrastructure types where no established playbook exists. The solutions we deliver are boutique by nature: custom\-designed to meet specific programmatic needs, site constraints, and operational models that vary from project to project.
  

The scope is broad, the problems are novel, and the pace of growth means we are constantly onboarding new infrastructure types and scaling models.  

If you thrive in ambiguity, enjoy the challenge of translating vague asks into engineered solutions, and want to shape how AWS builds and scales its infrastructure globally — this role is for you.  

We have an immediate opening for a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager III to drive capacity delivery across multiple non\-standard infrastructure programs worldwide. You will lead cross\-functional teams through the full lifecycle of infrastructure delivery — from upstream requirements definition and demand forecasting through design development, procurement, construction, commissioning, and deployment. You will develop and implement scalable mechanisms for tracking program health, drive data\-driven decisions influencing significant capital investments, and work with stakeholders across AWS to solve constraints, remove blockers, and accelerate delivery.  

Your work will span:  

* Requirements development — Working with internal customer teams to translate ambiguous needs into defined technical requirements, scope documents, and infrastructure specifications for novel deployment types
* Stakeholder management and influence — Navigating complex, matrixed organizational structures and influencing without authority to align diverse teams, secure resources, drive decisions, and maintain momentum across programs where no single team owns the end\-to\-end outcome
* Demand forecasting and capacity planning — Building initial demand models and scaling forecasts for programs where historical baselines don't exist, and refining them as programs mature
* Boutique design coordination — Partnering with engineering teams to develop tailored infrastructure solutions that meet unique programmatic constraints (environmental, regulatory, physical, operational)
* Multi\-year delivery execution — Driving complex, globally distributed projects from conceptual feasibility through budget approval, design, procurement, construction, and commissioning
* Cross\-program coordination — Identifying synergies, shared solutions, and lessons learned across a diverse portfolio of infrastructure types
* Mechanism development — Building scalable processes and reporting to monitor delivery health, drive accountability, and escalate to leadership as the portfolio grows


This role offers an opportunity to drive and influence business\-critical decisions impacting the long\-term future of AWS, working at the leading edge of emerging capability and service offerings. You must be comfortable managing remote project teams delivering novel — and sometimes pioneering — solutions across multiple countries and time zones; operating as the connective tissue between customer teams with undefined needs and engineering teams who build solutions; assessing and mitigating downstream risk; troubleshooting unforeseen implementation issues; removing barriers to project success; and operating effectively amid persistent uncertainty and change.  

Up to 15% domestic and international travel may be necessary to support AWS non\-standard infrastructure planning and scaling efforts.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Work upstream with internal customer teams to elicit, define, and document technical requirements for infrastructure programs that are often undefined or loosely scoped at inception
* Develop initial demand forecasts and capacity scaling models for emerging

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - Content protection and discoverability
jobs.description:
**Purpose of the role**

  

The way that academic research is being communicated to audiences around the globe is changing rapidly. Increasingly, research data can be consumed at scale through AI tools and machine intelligence, creating a moment of transition in research communication, and an opportunity to shape how millions discover, trust, and apply research, accelerating the translation of insight into real‑world impact faster than before.  



  

The purpose of this role is to turn Springer Nature’s traffic, usage and discovery data into the signals and evidence the team relies on to maximise the value of our content across the web, navigating this transition. This role sits at the intersection of **content discoverability, content protection and data intelligence** .  



  

You will help the organisation understand how Springer Nature content is being discovered, accessed and used across search engines, academic discovery services, AI\-powered tools, content aggregation platforms and other external channels. At the same time, you will identify and measure inappropriate access, automated scraping and content extraction activities to ensure discoverability is achieved without undermining platform traffic, entitlements or commercial value.  



  

You will own the analytical foundations of both disciplines: identifying and measuring the signals that indicate successful discovery, as well as those that indicate abuse. Working closely with product, platform, analytics and security teams, you will provide the evidence needed to shape strategy, prioritise interventions and measure outcome s.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Content Discoverability \& External Platform Analytics**

* Analyse how Springer Nature content is discovered across external channels, including search engines, scholarly discovery services, library platforms, aggregators, citation networks, AI\-powered discovery tools and emerging content platforms
* Develop and maintain a framework of discoverability metrics, signals and KPIs to measure the effectiveness of content distribution and discovery strategies
* Identify the external signals that indicate successful content discovery, engagement and conversion back to Springer Nature properties
* Measure the impact of metadata quality, indexing, platform integrations and content syndication on discoverability outcomes
* Track changes in referral patterns, search visibility and external platform behaviour, identifying opportunities and risks
* Evaluate the trade\-offs between maximising reach and preserving platform traffic, user engagement and commercial value
* Provide recommendations to product and business stakeholders on how content should be surfaced, exposed and protected across external ecosystems

Build analytical models to understand the relationship between discoverability, content consumption, platform traffic and downstream business outcomes  

* 

  

**Content Protection \& Traffic Intelligence**

* Analyse WAF, traffic and behavioural data, primarily in BigQuery, to identify scraping, bot activity and unauthorised content extraction using fingerprint analysis, behavioural signals and network data
* Build and maintain a portfolio of detection signals and continuously evolve them as threat actors change their tactics
* Measure detection performance through coverage, precision, false\-positive rates and baseline benchmarking
* Quantify the scale and commercial impact of content scraping and content leakage to support prioritisation and investment decisions
* Investigate incidents and anomalous traffic patterns, distinguishing legitimate institutional and authenticated users from malicious automation
* Work closely with the Security Specialist Engineer, who will implement and enforce controls, while you identify, measure and validate the underlying signals

Help define the evidence base for decisions about content exposure, rate limiting, entitlement enforcement and platform protections  

* 

  

**Insight, Reporting \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Design and maintain dashboards and reporting that communicate discoverability performance, content protection effectiveness and emerging risks
* Translate complex data findings into clear recommendations for product, platform, security and senior stakeholders
* Establish meaningful baselines, benchmarks and success measures for both discoverability and protection initiatives
* Support product strategy by providing evidence\-driven insights into user behaviour, content consumption patterns and external ecosystem trends

Contribute to experimentation and measurement frameworks that assess the impact of product, metadata, discovery and protection changes  

* 

**Essential Skills \& Experience**

* Strong SQL skills, particularly BigQuery, with experience working on large\-scale datasets.
* Strong analytical and statistical capability, including the ability to identify patterns, anomalies and behavioural trends
* Experience analysing web traffic, referral data and user journeys across digital products.
* Understanding of content discoverability, search and referral ecosystems, or the ability to quickly develop expertise in this area
* Interest in bot detection, behavioural analytics, fingerprinting and content protection challenges
* Ability to connect multiple data sources to build a coherent picture of user behaviour and content usage
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn data insights into actionable recommendations and compelling stakeholder narratives
Strong understanding of data security and governance  
* 

**Desirable**

* Python or other scripting experience for data analysis and automation
* Experience with dashboarding and visualisation platforms such as Looker, Grafana or similar tools
* Exposure to security analytics, threat intelligence or fraud detection
* Understanding of SEO, scholarly discovery services, content metadata or digital content distribution ecosystems

ONNEC Group are a leading independent technology partner and global integrator, with over 30 years experience, and a 800\+ team of global experts, specialising in providing end\-to\-end connectivity solutions that propel organisations everywhere.


From structured cabling to managed services, our end\-to\-end services give infrastructure that can be completely replied on. Design. Build. Deploy. Optimise. We offer a complete solution for business connectivity.


We are a rapidly growing organisation and finding and retaining the highest calibre of people is fundamental to us for the success of our business, we work hard to create a challenging, supportive and satisfying working environment for all our employees. ONNEC has successfully achieved the Investors in Diversity Foundational Award for our commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion in the workplace.


***IT Workplace Technology Project Manager \- FTC*** *is a highly visible role that requires commitment to providing a high\-quality service to meet customer demand.*


*The* ***IT Workplace Technology Project Manager \- FTC*** *will facilitate any project scope required by the client, including the relocation of user IT equipment in the UK and Europe. The position is very hands on with a strong focus on the customers’ requirements, activity coordination, system implementation, resource provisioning, statistics, asset management, financial justifications, documentation preparation, health and safety and service delivery.*


*You will have excellent communication and organisational skills with a sound understanding of moves add and changes, IT infrastructure, database, and project management.*


**Please note: This role will be based on a primary location of the customer offices at Canary Wharf in London, however travel will also be required across the EMEA region (Customer sites)**


What you’ll be doing as our **IT Workplace Technology Project Manager \- FTC**:


* Lead and deliver end\-to\-end projects across IT, AV, and structured cabling environments, including Moves, Adds, and Changes (MAC) and decommissioning activities.
* Manage and mentor project teams, ensuring quality, compliance, and health \& safety standards are consistently met.
* Oversee project planning, financial control, and reporting — including resource scheduling, quotations, invoicing, and supplier coordination.
* Manage Risks, ensuring that risks are reported, escalated as appropriate and managed to ensure mitigation or reducing impact to service.
* Act as primary client interface, ensuring service excellence and alignment with client processes and SLAs.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendors on infrastructure installs, desktop deployments, network and voice connectivity, and AV installations.
* Maintain accurate documentation, asset tracking, and system records across platforms such as ServiceNow, and Ariba.
* Maintain full systems access via mandatory Onnec and client training, eLearning and self\-attestation.
* Work as part of a small team, with cross collaboration to ensure delivery of a high volume of works.


**What we’re looking for in our IT Workplace Technology Project Manager \- FTC**:


*Essential*


* Relevant experience in IT project management within banking or large enterprise environments.
* Proven leadership and people management skills.
* Relevant experience in Workplace Technology project delivery – IT, AV, and structured cabling.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, MAC processes, and service delivery.
* Excellent communication, organisational, and client\-facing skills.
* Proficiency with MS Office and asset/ticketing systems (ServiceNow, etc.).
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritise tasks, and meet strict deadlines.
* Experience mentoring and developing internal and 3rd party technical teams.
* Strong attention to detail, ensuring works are delivered to the highest standards.
* Contributing to Continual Service Improvement for activities both within the project team, and the wider service.
* Available to manage works taking place out of hours, during weekends and evenings.


*Preferred but not Essential*


* PRINCE2 or ITIL® Foundation certification.
* COMPTIA Network\+ or equivalent technical accreditation.
* BICSI Technician or Data Centre certifications (CDCTP®, CDCMP®)
* Previous experience in financial services or data centre environments.


If you feel you have the required skills and experience, click **apply** now to be considered as our **Project / Programme Manager** – we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst II
jobs.description:
As a Senior Research Analyst II within the Acrylates and Oxo Alcohol Market Advisory Services team, you will contribute to the monthly data gathering, review and analysis for reports used by global chemical producers, traders, and procurement managers. You will focus on the EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa) region, specifically tracking trends and pricing within the Acrylate Monomers, MMA, Oxo Alcohols, and Plasticizers value chains.


**You Will**

* Price Discovery \& Reporting: Support in assessing monthly spot and contract prices for Acrylate Monomers (2\-EHA, BA, EA and MA), Methyl Methacrylate (MMA), Superabsorbent Polymers (SAP), Oxo\-Alcohols (2\-EH, n\-Butanol, iso\-Butanol), and various Plasticizers.
* Price Forecasting: Analyze and interpret how changes in upstream energy and feedstock costs (e.g., Propylene, Natural Gas) will interact with market forces to create multi\-year, monthly price forecasts for Acrylates, MMA, SAP and Oxo Alcohols.
* Report Creation: Assist in writing and compiling monthly Market Advisory reports andcontributing data for longer\-term World Analysis forecasts through 2060\. Regularly interfaces with global Market Advisory Services team members to ensure analysis consistency and to be kept abreast of global trends that could affect regional markets.
* Supply/Demand Modeling: Support in maintaining and updating Global Supply/DemandBalances for the EMEA region, as well as updating plant capacities, production rates and future expansions.
* Trade Flow Analysis: Work with the greater global ASAP and GOAP team to keep updated on arbitrage opportunities and global supply\-demand status.
* Client Support: Initially support and assist the EMEA Principal Analyst with scheduled calls and meetings to gather market intel, with the near\-term expectation the Senior Research Analyst II can soon handle some calls independently. Also eventually moving to the position of being able to independently respond to some unscheduled, incoming market queries.

**You Have:**

* University degree required. Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Engineering or Chemistry is highly preferred. Alternate degrees may include Finance, Mathematics, Journalism or Business Analytics with a demonstrated interest or minor in a science\-related field. Any real\-world chemical industry experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated organized ability to research through established contacts with diverse market participant channels in telephone, e\-mail and face\-to\-face interfaces; ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ideal candidate will have proficiency in Microsoft Office Professional suite, with emphasis on Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Candidate will be able to manage large datasets and interpret formulas to ensure accurate maintenance of customer\-facing data. Candidate will also be able to extrapolate internal data to help create customer\-facing charts, graphs and presentations.
* Exceptional written and spoken English is required for publishing reports for a global audience.
* Proficiency in other languages is a plus. Preference given to those with knowledge of Spanish, German, French or Arabic.
* The ideal candidate will be outgoing and understand this role requires a significant number of monthly phone calls, Zoom calls and meetings. Candidate must have an engaging personality and willingness to engage in cultivating both existing and new client\-facing relationships.

jobs.title: Graduate Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Please read the job description, criteria and application process notes carefully before applying. This role has a fixed start date of 11 January 2027 and is based full\-time on\-site in Central London. Closing date for applications will be mid October.**

**About Prevail Partners**


Prevail Partners is a leading British intelligence, security and operational support company. We help governments, NGOs and commercial organisations operate safely and effectively in some of the world's most complex environments by combining intelligence, technology and operational expertise. Our teams deliver actionable insight that helps clients manage risk, make informed decisions and achieve meaningful operational impact where it matters most.


Our shared mission is to deliver unrelenting excellence in everything we do, underpinned by integrity, curiosity, accountability and care.


**About the Role**


The Graduate Intelligence Analyst Programme is an opportunity for people looking to start their career in intelligence analysis to develop their problem\-solving and analytical skills while gaining practical insight into the intelligence field. At Prevail, the Graduate Intelligence Analyst will apply skills developed through study, professional experience, or personal research to help solve complex client problems through structured training and on\-the\-job learning.


The programme includes an initial three\-month training phase with structured lessons, rotations through project teams working on live operations and deliverables, and exposure to supporting functions such as Geospatial and Data. This is followed by a three\-month probationary period as a Graduate Intelligence Analyst within one of Prevail’s teams, applying training with support from peers, the manager, and a dedicated Mentor Analyst.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct Open\-Source Intelligence (OSINT) collection and analysis to support live client operations.
* Contribute to intelligence products and reports that inform client decision\-making.
* Support 24/7 monitoring activity by identifying, assessing, and escalating relevant developments.
* Collaborate with supporting functions, including Geospatial and Data, to enrich analysis and outputs.
* Present findings clearly and confidently in written reports and verbally to internal teams and, where relevant, clients.
* Continuously develop analytical tradecraft by incorporating feedback from the Mentor Analyst, manager, peers, and wider team.

  

**Requirements** **Essential Skills and Experience:**

* Recent university graduate, or professional actively seeking a career change into intelligence with proven self\-study and research in a related field.
* Understanding of Open\-Source Intelligence (OSINT) collection, tools, and analysis.
* Proactive, curious mindset, with the ability to learn quickly, innovate, contribute fresh ideas, challenge existing processes, and improve workflows.
* Strong understanding of current affairs, geopolitical trends, and national security issues, with the ability to analyse global events and international relations and assess their relevance to intelligence operations.
* Able to achieve SC security clearance, including meeting UK residency and vetting requirements.
* Available to start full\-time work on 11 January 2027 and able to commute to and work on\-site daily in a Central London office.
* Willing to join the team’s weekend duty rota after completing probation (time off in lieu for weekend hours worked).
* Strong IT literacy, including the Microsoft Office Suite.
* Able to handle sensitive information with discretion, professionalism, and respect for confidentiality.

**Desirable Skills and Experience:**

* Foreign language skills, particularly French, Russian, Arabic, or Farsi.
* Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI for presenting intelligence findings.
* Experience analysing large datasets and identifying trends
* Familiarity in tools such as Excel, SQL, or Python

**About You**

We are looking for someone who is intellectually curious, analytical, and motivated by complex problem solving. You will be proactive in building your intelligence tradecraft, open to feedback, and comfortable working in a structured team environment where accuracy, judgement, and discretion are essential.


You will bring:

* curiosity, proactivity, and a commitment to continuous learning.
* clear and confident communication skills, both verbally and in writing.
* professionalism, discretion, and the ability to work responsibly with sensitive information.

**Application Process**


1\. Application: Apply with your CV and a cover letter, along with your answers to the accompanying application questions. In your cover letter, tell us about the relevant knowledge you've built, whether through formal study or your own learning, and how it supports your ambitions for a career in intelligence.


2\. Initial screen: A 30\-minute video call with a member of the team. We'll talk about your background, your motivation and your understanding of the role.


3\. Second stage: A 30\-minute video call focused on your skills. We'll talk through how you approach problems, looking at your technical know\-how, problem\-solving and proactivity.

jobs.title: Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

As a Strategy Analyst in the commercial team, you'll work across commercial forecasting and partner\-level pricing for growth optimisation. You'll build and maintain the models, dashboards, and analytical infrastructure that underpin how we plan, track, and improve commercial performance. Your analysis and recommendations will directly inform partner strategy, pricing decisions, and performance management across Commercial, Risk, Capital Markets, Operations, Partnerships, and Product. This role is ideal for someone who wants to build systems, not just run analyses \- and who is excited by seeing their work directly shape commercial outcomes.  

  

Annual salary: £42,000 \- £54,000 OTE### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Support the production and continuous improvement of commercial forecasts \- inputs, outputs, scenarios, tracking, and variance analysis
* Build and maintain dashboards, self\-serve data infrastructure and tools (e.g. in Metabase) used across Commercial, Risk, Ops, and Capital Markets Produce driver breakdowns and structured performance summaries (leads, conversion, funded amount, mix)
* Run monthly recalibration and variance decomposition to explain under and overperformance
* Identify weaknesses in forecasting and implement improvements to modelling, input structures, and processes
* Analyse partner performance and pricing dynamics for growth opportunities
* Size the impact of pricing to optimise for commercial changes
* Support the development of structured commercial proposals and pricing recommendations
* Track commercial levers (expected vs actual impact) and run retrospectives on implemented changes
* Monitor partner performance post\-change and flag opportunities or issues
* Improve data structures to reduce manual work, duplication, and ad\-hoc requests
* Make recommendations that guide partner strategy and commercial decisions across teams

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Interest in fintech, lending, and commercial strategy
* 1\-3 years of experience in an analytical, data, or commercially oriented role \- or a strong graduate with relevant quantitative experience (e.g. coding in Python, R, Stata, or SQL)
* Strong SQL capability (required) and modelling skills in Excel; Python preferred, though experience with other analytical languages also valued
* Ability to build from scratch: models, dashboards, analyses \- not just work with existing outputs
* Clear, structured written communication: able to translate analysis into insight and recommendations
* High ownership mindset: you follow through and take responsibility for your outputs
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and bringing structure where processes are not yet fully defined
* Proactive: you look for improvements, not just instructions
* Curious about commercial outcomes, not just the numbers behind them
* A team\-first mindset: collaborative and willing to work across teams to get things right

  

### **Benefits**

 **Why join YouLend?*** Award\-Winning Workplace: YouLend has been recognised as one of the “Best Places to Work in 2024 and 2025” by the Sunday Times for being a supportive, diverse, and rewarding workplace.
* Award\-Winning Fintech: YouLend has been recognised as a “Top 250 Fintech Worldwide” company by CNBC.

**It's just getting fun*** We have developed powerful solutions, secured significant partnerships, and are growing rapidly.
* The global opportunity is still massive, and YouLend is a raw organisation where we are only just getting started.

**Lots of upsides*** High\-growth (\>100% growth during 2022 and 2023\), so clear outlook to compensation (bonus or share option appreciation) and career growth (through growth with the business).
* Well\-capitalised with supportive private equity backing.
* Part of Banking Circle Group with a fully licensed Luxembourg bank, which can provide a balance sheet and support European expansion in otherwise complex regulated markets.

**Motivating work environment*** A high\-quality team that pushes each other to succeed through direct feedback and aligned incentives.
* Strong, transparent team culture: we have each other’s backs.
* Independent work environment where results matter.
* Data\-driven culture and emphasis on speed (anti\-red tape).

**We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:*** Private Medical Insurance (via Vitality)
* EAP with Health Assured
* Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave
* Great office space (including a gym!) in Central London
* Subsidised lunch (via Feedr)
* Deliveroo allowance if working late in the office
* Monthly in\-office masseuse
* Team and Company socials
* Sports clubs

*At YouLend, we champion diversity and embrace equal opportunity employment practices. Our hiring, transfer, and promotion decisions are exclusively based on qualifications, merit, and business requirements, free from any discrimination based on race, gender, age, disability, religion, nationality, or any other protected basis under applicable law.*### **About YouLend**


YouLend is a rapidly growing FinTech that is the preferred embedded financing platform for many of the world’s leading e\-commerce platforms, tech companies, and Payment Service Providers.
