jobs.title: Alternatives Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential \- whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or an exciting new direction, we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

We’re one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with a network that covers more than 50 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our Asset Management Alternative’s team in the role of Alternatives Senior Business Analyst to help shape the Global Target Operating Model (GTOM) across private equity, private credit, real assets and hedge funds. This is a senior role at the heart of front\-to\-back transformation—defining scalable operating models, data\-driven solutions and platform capabilities that support growth, strengthen controls and improve efficiency across regions.

  

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you’ll have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK\-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

  



In this role you’ll:

* Lead end\-to\-end business analysis across complex GTOM change initiatives, from discovery through delivery and adoption.
* Elicit, analyse and document business requirements; translate strategy into actionable roadmaps and solution designs aligned to HSBC standards.
* Design and oversee front\-to\-back solutions spanning portfolio management, valuation, reporting and operational workflows across Alternatives.
* Define and govern data lineage, data flows and integration patterns across investment, operations and risk systems; drive data quality improvements.
* Evaluate, select and integrate market platforms (e.g., eFront, Allvue, Aladdin or equivalent) and partner with technology teams on scalable designs.
* Collaborate across business, operations, technology, risk and data teams globally (EMEA/APAC/Americas), embedding controls and ensuring consistent operating models.

  

To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements:

* Extensive experience in Asset Management/Alternatives with strong knowledge of private markets such as Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Assets and Hedge Funds.
* Proven track record as a Senior Business Analyst and/or Solutions Architect delivering front\-to\-back change in investment management.
* Strong data analysis capability, including SQL and experience working with data lineage, integration and governance frameworks.
* Hands\-on exposure to Alternatives platforms and ecosystems (e.g., Allvue, eFront, Arcesium, Anaplan, Citco Unity or similar).
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills—able to bridge business outcomes and technology delivery in a matrixed, global environment.
* Strategic, structured problem\-solver with strong documentation skills and an eye for automation, simplification and scalable design.

 **Opening up a world of opportunity.**

  

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces \- no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

  

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

The Senior Project Manager leads the successful delivery of large, complex, or multiple construction projects in the San Fernando Valley, with full accountability for safety, quality, schedule, contract compliance, and financial performance from preconstruction through closeout. This is a daily, on\-site leadership role — you'll be hands\-on with your project teams, clients, and field leadership every day, not managing from a distance.  

You'll mentor Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, and Project Engineers, build long\-term client relationships, and represent the company as a trusted senior advisor throughout the project lifecycle.  

The role reports to the Project Director, Project Executive, Vice President of Operations, or other assigned supervisor, and works closely with clients, consultants, trade partners, field leadership, and company leadership.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Champion project safety, quality, scheduling, and risk management across assigned projects, partnering with field leadership on expectations.
* Maintain full accountability for project forecasting, budgeting, billing, cash flow, and overall financial performance.
* Lead administration of prime contracts, subcontracts, purchase orders, and project agreements, directing compliance and change management processes.
* Evaluate cost impacts, forecast variances, and contractual risks; implement corrective actions and support the resolution of claims or disputes.
* Lead, mentor, and develop Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, Project Engineers, and other project team members.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and industry partners, serving as a trusted senior advisor.
* Lead project delivery from preconstruction through closeout — planning, constructability, logistics, procurement, staffing, and execution strategy.
* Champion integration of VDC/BIM processes to support constructability, coordination, and risk mitigation.
* Oversee turnover, commissioning, and closeout activities through successful project completion.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* 12\+ years of progressively responsible construction industry experience.
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Demonstrated success managing large or complex construction projects and project teams.
* Expert understanding of construction contracts, project controls, scheduling, procurement, cost management, and risk management.
* Advanced understanding of construction means and methods, constructability, VDC/BIM processes, and quality management systems.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction management platforms such as Procore, CMiC, and/or Navisworks.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills, with the ability to build trust across clients, teams, and company leadership.
* OSHA 30\-Hour certification, or ability to obtain within established company timelines.

### **Benefits**

  

* Real leadership of large, complex projects — shaping delivery strategy from preconstruction through closeout, not just executing someone else's plan.
* Direct, daily involvement with your project team and clients in the San Fernando Valley — hands\-on leadership, not remote oversight.
* A clear seat at the table as a senior advisor to clients and company leadership.
* 100% employee\-owned (ESOP) company with a track record dating back to 1925 — your work has a direct stake in the outcome.
* Full benefits package: competitive pay, bonus program, medical/dental/vision insurance, PTO/sick leave, life insurance, 401(k) with match, and a student debt assistance program.
* Target annual bonus, plus a vehicle allowance or company vehicle (based on availability) and a fuel card.

### **About W.E. O'Neil Construction**


Building Great Relationships since 1925! 100% employee\-owned general contractor. We build nationally, with locations in AZ, CA, CO, IL, TN, and TX.  

  

W.E. O'Neil Construction has seen steady growth since its founding in 1925 in Chicago by the O'Neil family. Now 100% employee\-owned (ESOP), we embrace people as our number one asset.  

  

Our award\-winning teams are recognized as industry leaders. Our longevity can be attributed to our excellent staff of professionals, our integrity, our commitment to customer satisfaction, and our ability to embrace technology. Our combination of the financial strength of a large national contractor and the responsiveness of a small company brings the best of both worlds to our clients.  

  

Our experience covers virtually every commercial market sector using a broad range of project delivery methods including design\-build, design assist, construction management at risk and lump sum bid.

Program Manager, Technology
jobs.description:
**About the company**

 **Brio Water Technology, a Home Organizers, Inc. company,** is a market leading water products brand that has helped millions stay hydrated through its unique and innovative product line. We offer full home water solutions designed to elevate the way people hydrate, combining sophisticated technology with modern, top tier design to deliver exceptional performance, customer satisfaction, and enhanced functionality. **Home Organizers, Inc.** is the parent organization behind a portfolio of well\-known home products and services brands, including Closet World, Closets by Design, Brio Water Technology, and others. With decades of experience supporting innovation, design, manufacturing, and customer focused solutions, Home Organizers helps its brands deliver high quality products and services that improve everyday living for households across the country. **About the role**  

As part of Home Organizers, Inc., Brio Water Technology is looking for a Program Manager, Technology to build the program governance, standards, and processes that do not yet exist within our technology organization. This is a foundational, hands\-on role for someone who walks into ambiguity and sees opportunity rather than a problem.  

This role is deliberately two jobs in one. As the business analyst, you define the problem, outline the scope, and make sure the solution fits what the business actually needs. As the program manager, you own the budget, hold the timeline, and deliver through the team. We are looking for someone who does both, and who knows which one a given moment calls for.  

The right person starts with people, not plans: they talk to our internal customers, learn their pain points, understand the current state, and use what they learn to design the processes and procedures we do not yet have. They are proactive by default. Wherever there is a compliance concern, an undocumented procedure, or a process with no owner, they step in, create clarity, and carry it until a permanent owner is in place. They do not wait to be assigned work; they find the gaps, close them, and hand them off.  

This person arrives with Agile coaching experience already in hand. As our teams mature and grow, they will take on Scrum Master duties and coach teams of varying size and experience. All of it requires influence without authority, and comfort operating alongside senior leaders and executives who hold deep institutional knowledge of how our systems actually behave. **Objectives of the role*** Establish the program governance, standards, and compliance foundation our technology organization does not yet have, in close partnership with internal stakeholders.
* Take ownership of gaps: compliance concerns, undocumented procedures, and unowned processes, creating clarity and carrying them until a permanent owner is in place.
* Lead cross\-functional technology programs end to end, from problem definition and requirements through delivery, coordinating teams and vendors outside your direct management chain.
* Take on the role of Scrum Master, Agile Coach, and business analyst for one or more teams as our organization matures.

 **What you'll do*** **Strategic planning.** Define the roadmap, goals, and long\-term vision for assigned programs, and sequence the work so near\-term delivery builds toward the target state.
* **Business analysis.** Define the problem before the solution is chosen. Elicit and document requirements, map current and future state, set scope, and write acceptance criteria, confirming that what gets built fits what the business actually needs.
* **Stakeholder communication.** Serve as the primary bridge between project teams, executives, and external partners. Run working sessions, keep everyone current on status, risks, and decisions, and work directly with stakeholders up to the executive level and with subject matter experts who hold deep institutional knowledge of how our systems behave.
* **Change management and adoption.** Many of our teams have worked in the same systems, using the same processes, for a very long time. Adoption here is earned, not announced. Communicate change early and often, brief the leadership of each area before rollout so their questions are answered ahead of go\-live, and provide the training and hands\-on support people need to work confidently in the new process. Success is measured by adoption, not by the go\-live date.
* **Program delivery.** Lead cross\-functional technology programs end to end: system implementations, migrations, and infrastructure initiatives, coordinating teams outside your direct management chain, including external vendors, internal business stakeholders, and technical SMEs.
* **Cross\-project coordination.** Manage interdependencies across concurrent projects, surface scheduling and resource conflicts early, and drive them to resolution.
* **Budget oversight.** Allocate resources, forecast expenses, and own budget adherence and variance tracking for assigned programs, including vendor software licensing, capital expenses for infrastructure upgrades, and cloud costs.
* **Risk management.** Identify roadblocks and risks early and implement corrective action. Maintain the risk register, change control process, policies and procedures, and audit\-ready documentation.
* **Governance and gap ownership.** Stand up program governance where none exists today. Proactively identify compliance concerns, undocumented procedures, and processes without a clear owner; create interim structure, carry ownership, and hand off to permanent owners once established.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
CourtAvenue is a company of industry experts accelerating digital transformation for the world’s most ambitious companies.

At CourtAvenue, you will be a part of a culture powered by entrepreneurs, technologists, data scientists and the habitually restless dedicated and energized to design products and services that transform businesses while optimizing them for growth. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow within a culture that values innovation while focusing on redesigning the experience between consumer and service (or product) by leveraging a fluid, seamless, and thoroughly transparent engagement.  

Our Senior Technical Project Managers lead agile delivery for CourtAvenue’s most complex, multi\-workstream digital transformation programs — composable platform builds, design systems, and phased legacy\-site migrations. This role owns the day\-to\-day execution of a program’s technical and creative workstreams, translating a signed Statement of Work into sprint\-level delivery while partnering closely with account leadership on client strategy.



This Sr. Project Manager runs agile ceremonies — sprint planning, daily scrums, backlog refinement, retrospectives — across a co\-delivery model that embeds client developers and designers directly on the team, and holds the program to its scope, budget, and gate\-review schedule. Comfort with technical concepts (headless/composable CMS, API\-driven integrations, data layer and analytics implementation) and confidence managing scope through formal change\-request processes are essential.



### **Responsibilities**


* Own day\-to\-day delivery of a multi\-workstream digital transformation program — platform/CMS build, design system, content, and phased migration — from mobilization through launch and stabilization
* Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, daily scrums, backlog refinement, retrospectives) across a co\-delivery model that embeds client developers and designers directly on the team
* Translate the Statement of Work into a sprint\-level backlog, an integrated program timeline, and a RAID log, keeping scope, budget, and schedule aligned to the signed engagement
* Coordinate parallel workstreams spanning platform build, design system and token governance, system integrations, and legacy\-site migration waves
* Manage the change\-request process end to end — flag scope triggers early, document schedule/budget impact, and drive sign\-off before repriced work begins
* Partner with engineering and architecture leads on technical delivery planning — environments, CI/CD, code review cadence, and release management
* Own gate\-review readiness at each program milestone, confirming technical proof, data and measurement continuity, and team\-readiness criteria before the next phase begins
* Track quality gates including accessibility (WCAG 2\.1 AA), Core Web Vitals performance, and cross\-device QA sign\-off ahead of every release
* Facilitate stakeholder workshops — goals and objectives, alignment, governance — to keep the program grounded in agreed priorities and success criteria
* Build and maintain the integrated delivery timeline across CourtAvenue, client stakeholders, and any subcontracted teams
* Identify and escalate risks and blockers — resourcing gaps, dependencies, vendor readiness — before they threaten the delivery schedule
* Collaborate with the Account Management team and report program status, risks, and milestones to the Director of Client Delivery
* Communicate succinctly and credibly across client executives, technical teams, and creative teams, adapting the message to each audience
### **Requirements**


* 5\-7\+ years of technical/agile project or program management experience, ideally delivering composable CMS, platform migration, or design system programs
* Deep working knowledge of agile/Scrum methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog management, and co\-delivery models with embedded client developers
* Agency or consultancy delivery experience strongly preferred
* Working comfort with technical concepts — headless/composable CMS architecture, API\-driven integrations, data layer and analytics implementation, and CI/CD basics
* Experience managing multi\-workstream programs with parallel platform, design, content, and migration tracks
* Proven ability to run formal change\-request and gate\-review processes on fixed\-fee or milestone\-based engagements
* Skilled at managing scope, budget, and risk across cross\-functional and cross\-organizational delivery teams
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, written and verbal
* PMP, CSM/PSM, or SAFe certification a plus; bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience
$100,000 \- $130,000 a year

Overview:

BAI, a defense contractor, is seeking an Information Security Analyst with 3\+ years of experience, to support the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity practices across assigned information systems and environments at Naval Base Ventura Point Mugu Ca. This position executes security protocols and procedures, monitors compliance with established security requirements, conducts assessments and audits, supports accreditation activities, and provides technical guidance on security tools and controls. Opportunities for career advancement, excellent benefits and long\-term stability are some of the advantages of our growing, employee\-focused company. **Salary**
The typical annual salary range for this position is $110,000\.00 USD to $140,000\.00 USD. Salary will be based on current qualifications, directly related experience, geographic location, and possible contractual requirements which could fall outside of this range.  


Responsibilities:
* Between 3 and 10 years of practical CEAT computer security experience in secure network and system design, analysis, procedure/test generation, test execution and implementation of computer/network security mechanisms

* **CYBER**
* Works closely with the Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), Cybersecurity Lead, system owners, and functional support/technical teams to protect computer networks, information systems, digital files, and critical electronic infrastructure
* Implements and monitors security controls, protocols, and procedures
* Protects networks, systems, information, and critical infrastructure
* Conducts vulnerability assessments, audits, risk reviews and rapid response reporting and data calls
* Monitors for and respond to security incidents, breaches, and malware in coordination with the ISSM and/or Cybersecurity Lead
* Prepares and maintains accreditation and compliance documentation
* Supports the implementation and use of security tools
* Provides security training and recommend improvements to security processes and controls

* **DevSecOps**

* Ensures the entire DevOps team, including developers and operations teams, share responsibility for following security best practices
* Enables automated security checks at each stage of software delivery by integrating security controls, tools, and processes into the DevOps workflow
* Assists in the continuous integration, continuous delivery/deployment (CI/CD), continuous feedback, and continuous operations cycle


Qualifications:
* IAT/IAM II as per DoD Manual 8140; Certifications: Security\+, CISSP, or NSA equivalent
* Experience working with the Risk Management Framework processes
* Strong DEVSECOPS (proficient with Linux is a plus)
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills—verbal, non\-verbal, written, and listening for staff, customer, and organizational level communications, both formal and informal
* Ability to work independently, self\-starter
* Working knowledge and use of Microsoft Office suite programs, MS Word, Excel, Access, and PowerPoint

**Degree:** BS or BA degree in Computer Information Systems or a relevant technical discipline

**Allowable Substitution:** An additional 6 years of relevant work experience may be substituted for a Bachelor’s Degree, or 4 additional years of work experience with a relevant Associate’s Degree

**Condition of Employment:** Must have a T5 background investigation, active Top Secret Security Clearance, and be able to maintain a DoD Top Secret Security Clearance. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

The applicant must have US citizenship at the time of application.

Apex Companies is seeking a GIS/Data Analyst 2 to support environmental, remediation, compliance, asset management, and engineering projects throughout California. This role combines geospatial analysis, database management, data visualization, and technical support to help project teams deliver high\-quality services to clients across the environmental and infrastructure sectors.



The ideal candidate is proficient in GIS software, spatial analysis, data management, and reporting, and enjoys working with multidisciplinary teams to transform complex datasets into actionable information.


### **Key Responsibilities**


### **GIS Analysis \& Mapping**


* Develop, maintain, and update GIS databases and geodatabases.
* Create high\-quality maps, figures, exhibits, and web\-based mapping applications.
* Perform spatial analysis to support environmental investigations, remediation projects, permitting, compliance, and asset management programs.
* Integrate data from multiple sources, including field data collection systems, GPS equipment, databases, and client systems.

### **Data Management \& Analytics**


* Manage large environmental and engineering datasets.
* Conduct quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) reviews of GIS and analytical data.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations using GIS and business intelligence tools.
* Assist project managers in tracking project metrics, schedules, budgets, and performance data.

### **Technical Support**


* Support environmental scientists, engineers, geologists, and project managers with mapping and data deliverables.
* Prepare technical graphics for reports, proposals, and client presentations.
* Maintain standardized workflows for data collection, storage, and reporting.
* Support implementation of enterprise GIS and data management initiatives.

### **Client \& Team Collaboration**


* Participate in project planning and technical meetings.
* Coordinate with clients, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders regarding GIS and data requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and data management solutions.

### **Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geography, Environmental Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field.
* 3\+years of GIS and data management experience.
* Experience with ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.
* Knowledge of relational databases and data management principles.
* Experience preparing professional maps and technical figures.Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and data quality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative team player with a client\-service mindset.

  


### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience supporting environmental consulting, remediation, groundwater, compliance, utility, or infrastructure projects.
* Working knowledge of:
	+ SQL
	+ Python
	+ Power BI
	+ Field Maps
	+ Survey123
	+ Experience Builder
	+ Web App Builder
* Familiarity with environmental databases and analytical laboratory datasets.
* Experience developing automated workflows and dashboards.

### **What Success Looks Like**


* Delivers accurate GIS products and data deliverables on schedule.
* Maintains high data integrity and QA/QC standards.
* Helps project teams improve efficiency through technology and automation.
* Supports growth of GIS and data management capabilities across California operations


**Why you'll love working for us:**


* Company\-subsidized medical and dental.
* Company\-paid life, short, and long\-term disability.
* 401k match, tuition assistance, and more.
* Cross\-training and the ability to work on a variety of projects.

Description du poste:
**Leader français de l’assurance** **auto** **en ligne depuis 1992, Direct Assurance, entité du Groupe AXA, propose également des offres d’assurance habitation, moto et** **santé.**
Aujourd'hui, **plus de deux millions de clients nous font confiance** grâce à un tarif adapté et une gestion des sinistres personnalisée.  

Dans un marché assurantiel très compétitif, Direct Assurance conçoit des solutions adaptées aux besoins de ses clients en défendant leur pouvoir d’achat.**Nous faisons de l'expérience client une priorité** en mettant à disposition une gamme de produits simple, claire et performante.  

**Si vous recherchez un environnement convivial, dynamique, digital et tourné vers l'innovation, au sein d'une entreprise en croissance, rejoignez\-nous !** **Vous allez aimer grandir à nos côtés.****Vous allez aimer innover avec nous.****Vous allez aimer que nos clients nous adorent.****VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS**
------------------------------

  

Au sein du pôle Pilotage de flux, Data et Outil de la relation client, vous serez rattaché au Responsable opérations analytics commercial \& sinistres dans une équipe de 5 collaborateurs.  

Votre mission principale sera de guider les prises de décisions en matière d'optimisation des parcours client, d'amélioration de la productivité et suivi de la performance, tout en soutenant la croissance et optimisant la productivité de nos call centers en lien avec le plan stratégique de l'entreprise.
Votre expertise technique Databricks combinée à la compréhension de l'environnement opérationnel, des process et de nos outils de la relation client sera clé pour réaliser des analyses pertinentes et fiables, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers et data.
Vous occuperez également le rôle de référent technique Databricks de l'équipe, accompagnant la migration vers Unity Catalog, l'évolution des pipelines et les bonnes pratiques de développement. **Vos missions :****Mise en place de reporting de pilotage*** Sécuriser l’environnement reporting existant
* Assurer le suivi de production des indicateurs au quotidien
* Accompagner la mise en place de nouveaux indicateurs pertinents du suivi opérationnel en collaboration avec les sites opérationnels et les équipes métiers
* Enrichir l’environnement existant dans le respect des standards de programmation

 **Analyse de la performance opérationnelle*** Accompagner la forte croissance de Direct Assurance, notamment avec la croissance des effectifs, la croissance de site opérationnel pour en anticiper et comprendre les effets.
* Contribuer aux analyses permettant d’améliorer les performances des équipes opérationnelles
* Identifier les axes d’amélioration et les drivers de sous/ sur performance afin d’aider les équipes à construire leur plan d’actions.

 **Accompagnement des projets d’entreprise*** Travailler en collaboration étroite avec les experts métier pour comprendre les problématiques opérationnelles et traduire les enjeux métier en suivi data ;
* Accompagner la transformation de la Relation Client avec les enjeux d’IA
* Définir et suivre les indicateurs de succès et anticiper les risques, notamment dans la cadre de notre stratégie de contact ;
* Formaliser des scenarii de décision et des préconisations pour faciliter la prise de décision ;

 **R****éférent technique Data*** Être le point focal technique sur les sujets Databricks, pipeline engineering et bonnes pratiques DevOps de l'équipe
* Piloter la migration des notebook Databricks vers Unity Catalog : définir la stratégie, planifier les étapes, valider la conformité et les performances
* Établir et maintenir les standards de développement des pipelines (code review, testing, documentation, versioning)
* Supporter et former l'équipe aux nouvelles technologies et pratiques post\-migration
* Anticiper les risques techniques et proposer des solutions d'optimisation et de scalabilité

  

**VOTRE PROFIL**
----------------

  

Vous êtes un professionnel **passionné par la data**, avec au moins **5 ans d'expérience, idéalement dans le conseil en management des organisations et des systèmes d’information.**  

Vos compétences analytiques, organisationnelles et votre approche pragmatique sont des atouts précieux.  

Votre aisance relationnelle pour échanger régulièrement avec d’autres équipes (techniques ou non techniques) et fructifier concrètement chacun de ces échanges sont essentiels. **Vous avez des compétences techniques en :*** Python, Pyspark, SQL
* Expertise confirmée avec Databricks (pipelines, Unity Catalog)
* Expérience avec DevOps et CI/CD
* Expérience avec Versioning (Git) et code review
* Connaissance d’un outil de visualisation (PowerBi, tableau, ...)

  

Une connaissance du **secteur de l’assurance** serait un plus.

  

Des déplacements ponctuels en France ou à l’étranger seront à prévoir.  

Le poste est basé à Suresnes (92\) à proximité de la Défense.  

**POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?**
-----------------------------


Nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs ! Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux.

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. The Future Forward organization is Intuitive’s advanced concepts group. We explore emerging technologies, prototype next\-generation solutions, and build software experiences that shape the future of robotic\-assisted surgery.

Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. * Responsible for incorporating feedback from Investigators to identify credible, actionable intelligence.

* Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Business, related field or work experience
* Minimum 10 years of experience in financial fraud investigations or related law enforcement
* Advanced understanding of fraud and risk, working with internal management, and acting as a liaison with the law enforcement community at the local, state, federal, and international levels
* Ability to manage staff and/or work remotely as the business model has the team spread across diverse geographies
* Ability to coordinate, work with and gain the trust of business stakeholders, technical resources, and third\-party vendors
* Able to articulate sophisticated fact patterns to non\-technical line of business risk partners and memorialize investigations into regular reporting requirements

jobs.description:
Overview:
**170\+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.**  

At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world\-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.

  

Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.

  

The Intelligence Analyst, assigned to a specific client, will monitor open\-source intelligence (OSINT) software and various OSINT sources to proactively identify risks to company's facilities, traveling employees, and vehicle fleets. The Analyst plays a pivotal role in enhancing the client's overall security measures by conducting research, proactively identifying threats, contributing to the development of robust risk management procedures, and assisting with incident management. This role is encouraged to recommend and work towards continuous improvement and proactive measures to uphold the client's commitment to safety. **This is a temporary full\-time position for four months, which may be longer or shorter based on business needs.**


Responsibilities:
* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Monitor open\-source intelligence (OSINT) software and a variety of OSINT sources to proactively identify risks to company facilities, traveling employees, and a fleet of company vehicles.
* Conduct research and analysis of identified risks and transmit alerts to key stakeholders.
* Assist Security Dispatchers with day\-to\-day security operations tasks, as needed.
* Receive real\-time alerts and quickly triage disruptions to determine their validity and relevance to the client.
* Collect, evaluate, and disseminate intelligence to key stakeholders in support of action plans based on credibility and likelihood.
* Effectively and calmly manage communications from various sources with team members and management, providing clear and relevant event details.
* Thoroughly document disruptive events that affect the safety and security of fleet vehicles with correct grammar and spelling within incident management tools for situational awareness and escalation, if necessary.
* Work collaboratively in a dynamic team environment and cross\-functionally with fleet operations.
* Contribute to procedures and processes to standardize and enhance risk management.
* Provide emergency and non\-emergency security system monitoring, event dispatch, emergency notification services and send alerts through mass\-communication system.
* Process and maintain a variety of standard operating procedures, emergency plans, documents, logs, and reports.
* Make recommendations to enhance controls and processes based on analysis findings.
* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and playbooks for threat analysis and provide feedback for future improvements.
* All other duties, as assigned.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a related field and/or three to five years of experience in a Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) or similar role, such as national security or criminal intelligence analysis. Prior completion of threat research, identification, and trends as well as OSINT tools/platforms proficiency.  

* Able to conduct thorough and in\-depth threat research and analysis.
* Familiarity with OSINT techniques for collecting, analyzing, and validating data from open sources, including search engine queries, social media monitoring, website analysis, and public records.
* Understanding of incident response procedures, including incident identification, triage, escalation, and recovery.
* Able to quickly adapt and excel in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment with substantial levels of ambiguity.
* Ethical mindset and respect for data/user privacy and confidentiality.
* Able to work collaboratively with other SOC team members, management, and cross\-functional teams.
* Continuous learner and adaptable to the evolving autonomous vehicle landscape.
* Composed under pressure during security incidents and emergencies.
* Resilient and self\-motived mindset.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Able to analyze complex situations and recommend solutions.
* Attentive to detail and accuracy.
* Able to multi\-task and organize workload for effective implementation.
* Computer skills; Microsoft Office.

**Working Conditions:**
With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting.
* Travel, as required.

Benefits:

Benefit options include employer\-paid life and AD\&D, voluntary life and AD\&D, medical, (HSA) Health Savings Account, (FSA) Flexible Savings Account, dental, vision, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, 401(K), paid time off (vacation, personal, sick, and holidays) and several employee assistance\-related programs. jobs.title: Physical Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Pivot Point Solutions**
=========================



Pivot Point Solutions is a California\-based consulting firm that delivers experienced field professionals to construction and utility organizations across the state. We partner with contractors, program owners, and utility clients to provide skilled inspection, construction management, and field support personnel who keep infrastructure projects safe, compliant, and on schedule.



Our team understands the demands of active construction environments, from underground gas and electric infrastructure to large\-scale utility programs. By pairing deep industry knowledge with a responsive, hands\-on approach, we help clients maintain quality, meet regulatory requirements, and keep field operations running smoothly on some of California's most critical infrastructure projects.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Title:** Physical Security Project Manager  

**Sector:** Physical Security / Construction  

**Seniority:** Senior Level  

**Primary Locations:** Santa Cruz or Santa Clara, CA  

**Travel:** Occasional travel to Monterey and San Bernardino, CA  

**Job Type:** Hybrid – Office, Field \& Home  

**Contract Length:** 1 Year \+  

**Compensation:** $58\.00 \- $80\.00/hour


**Role Overview**
-----------------



Pivot Point Solutions is seeking an experienced Physical Security Project Manager to lead the planning and field execution of complex physical security and low\-voltage system projects throughout California. This role will oversee projects involving access control, video surveillance/CCTV, intrusion detection, perimeter protection, intercoms, and supporting electrical and low\-voltage infrastructure.



The ideal candidate brings at least seven years of relevant project management experience and a strong field construction background. This position requires someone who can move comfortably between project planning and active job sites, coordinate contractors and technical teams, evaluate installation conditions, manage budgets and schedules, and oversee testing and commissioning while maintaining disciplined project documentation and governance.


**Your Day\-to\-Day Activities**
--------------------------------


* Manage physical security and low\-voltage projects from planning and site assessment through installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, resource requirements, milestones, and project documentation.
* Conduct job walks and site assessments to validate design requirements, installation conditions, constructability, and project risks.
* Coordinate installation of access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarms, intercoms, perimeter security, and supporting infrastructure.
* Manage security integrators, subcontractors, technicians, vendors, and other project resources.
* Coordinate physical security activities with IT, Corporate Security, facilities, construction teams, and business stakeholders.
* Review construction drawings, wiring diagrams, technical specifications, and installation requirements.
* Coordinate procurement of equipment, materials, permits, and other resources necessary for project execution.
* Monitor field activities for safety, workmanship, quality, schedule adherence, and compliance with project requirements.
* Troubleshoot technical and construction issues and coordinate solutions with installation teams and stakeholders.
* Oversee inspection, functional testing, commissioning, and turnover of installed security systems.
* Maintain accurate project records, including risk and issue logs, change documentation, as\-built information, progress reports, and closeout packages.
* Track project budgets, labor hours, material costs, forecasts, and overall financial performance.
* Identify scope changes and coordinate appropriate change management and change order documentation.
* Provide structured project status reporting to project sponsors, clients, and internal stakeholders.
* Proactively identify project risks, dependencies, and field constraints and drive mitigation plans through resolution.
* Coordinate final project handoff to operations and support teams.

**The Job Requirements**
------------------------


* 7\+ years of relevant experience managing physical security, low\-voltage, electrical, or closely related field construction projects.
* Direct experience managing field installation projects involving physical security systems.
* Strong knowledge of access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarms, perimeter protection, or related security technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise access control or video management platforms such as AMAG, Software House, Genetec, or comparable systems.
* Strong understanding of low\-voltage construction and installation practices.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, technical specifications, and related project documentation.
* Experience managing contractors, security integrators, technicians, vendors, and other field resources.
* Experience conducting site assessments, job walks, inspections, testing, and commissioning.
* Strong project management experience across scope, schedule, budget, risk, change, resources, and project documentation.
* Experience operating within structured PMO processes and maintaining project governance documentation.
* Strong communication, leadership, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel between project locations.
* Ability to work in active construction environments and wear required PPE, including FR clothing, hard hat, safety vest, and appropriate safety footwear.
* Ability to work a hybrid schedule across office, field, and home environments.
* Ability to support projects primarily in Santa Cruz and Santa Clara, with occasional travel to Monterey and San Bernardino.

**You'll Stand Out If You Have**
-------------------------

jobs.description:
Posted Thursday, September 24, 2026 at 8:00 AM
**Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services**


At HH Global, we help the world's most recognized brands turn their growth ideas into measurable impact through responsible marketing activation. We are a global marketing activation partner that connects brands to their customers and delivers sustainable marketing activation at scale. With over 4,000 colleagues across more than 55 countries, you'll join a diverse, high\-performing community, empowered to deliver sustainable, innovative solutions for our clients.


**Purpose of the Job**


Our client offers a suite of devices and tools that are used daily by billions and trusted by over 6 million businesses. Our client’s Product Graphics team manages all on\-product artwork across their hardware portfolio—including brand identity, repairability, and regulatory compliance. They partner closely with Industrial Design, Product Safety \& Compliance, and Engineering to deliver seamless hardware experiences.


As a Product Graphics Program Manager, you will serve as the point of contact for end\-to\-end product graphics workflow, intake management, and project execution. You will bridge design and production to ensure visual quality, technical precision, and regulatory integrity across all physical product markings and labels. From receiving direction to driving strategy, you will establish operational rigor and cross\-functional alignment from concept through mass production. This role requires exceptional planning, adaptability, and the ability to balance multiple complex programs across global teams.


*This role is hybrid (3\+ days a week onsite), based in Mountain View, CA.*


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Program Governance \& Execution**
* + Own and partner with client teams for end\-to\-end program life cycles across hardware development gates.
	+ **Track and manage the Product Graphics Worklog from creation to archive, proactively identifying risks, mitigations, and schedule dependencies.**
	+ **Build and maintain single\-source\-of\-truth program documentation, including Program Decks, Graphics trackers, DRI matrices, and CMF Process Sketchbooks.**
	+ **Drive early technical readiness testing, such as laser mark feasibility and compliance alignment, ensuring timely reviews and client partner sign\-offs.**
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Communication**
* + Act as the central operational hub between our client’s Product Graphics Designers, Industrial Design (ID), CMF team, Hardware Engineering, Product Management, Compliance, and external manufacturing partners.
	+ Maintain an active in\-person presence to foster cross\-team client relationships, align stakeholder expectations, and drive consensus during critical build gates.
	+ Lead regular working sessions, track action items, and distribute clear, asynchronous program updates and status reports across global time zones.
	+ Represent the client team in critical meetings to track actions, milestones, and deliverables.
	+ Provide definitive resolution for program graphics decisions in the absence of cross\-functional alignment.
* **Process Strategy \& Operational Excellence**
* + Identify operational gaps in technical graphics workflows and build scalable, standardized frameworks to resolve bottlenecks.
	+ Drive quarterly task planning, backlog prioritization, and long\-term designer capacity and workload allocation.
	+ Manage physical sample requests, digital asset allocation, and procurement needs to support testing and client executive reviews.

**Knowledge, Skills \+ Experience**


Minimum Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or design\-related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience in hardware, product graphics, CMF, or consumer electronics
* Experience managing hardware development lifecycles and collaborating with manufacturing partners
  

Preferred Qualifications


* Proven track record of driving cross\-functional alignment across design, engineering, and compliance teams
* Deep technical understanding of manufacturing processes and capabilities, printing processes, and cosmetic finishing
* Strong organizational skills with proficiency in building clear decks, workflow trackers, and program frameworks
* Self\-starter capable of driving direction, resolving ambiguities, and influencing cross\-functional leadership without formal authority
* Ability to multitask, analyze opportunities, proactively solve problems and accomplish challenging objectives with minimal direction
* Effectively navigate and operate in a deadline\-driven, rapidly changing work environment
* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality
* Possesses a love of efficiency, the desire to produce a high\-quality deliverable, and an ability to execute against multiple projects in a technical work environment with often uncertain circumstances
  

For New York and California applicants: The salary range for this position is $130,000 to $150,000 annually. Actual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors and are unique to each candidate, including skill set, experience, certifications and work location. This range may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.


The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus targets, benefits and/or other applicable incentives.


**You belong in our global community**


Belonging is at the heart of HH Global. We don’t just talk about inclusion; our teams recognize it as a fundamental part of our culture. Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services and bring your authentic self to a team that values you for who you are.


HH Global is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applications without regard to protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About the role:**


The Data Analyst's duties include developing, executing, and refining service requests, which may involve routine monitoring of online platforms for potential security and operational hazards, escalation procedures, and data report creation. This role involves direct interaction with clients and SIS management and requires providing specialized guidance on security intelligence matters. The ideal candidate possesses a robust foundation in compliance and data analytics, with proficiency in SQL, Python, Tableau, and other relevant tools. This position reports to the Senior Retail Operations Manager

**In this role, your responsibilities will be:**

* Investigative data analysis, pulling and reconciling data across multiple systems
* Use statistical and machine\-learning techniques to build scalable systems.
* Maintain and update live data pipelines and operationalize new data pipelines as additional data sources are identified within the scope of deliverables.
* Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of the Client’s historical business data to help automate and optimize key processes.
* Design, development, and evaluation of highly innovative models for predictive learning.
* Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for large\-scale data analyses, model development, validation, and implementation.
* Building SOPs for gathering data and searching specific systems
* Regular control monitoring report resolutions
* Use individual problem\-solving and analytical skills to authenticate customers
* Perform other related duties as required
* Design, build, and deploy AI\-based analytical workflows (including LLM\-powered tools and agentic pipelines) to automate security intelligence monitoring, anomaly detection, and reporting tasks.
* Develop, test, and refine prompts for AI/LLM applications; fine\-tune models on domain\-specific data to improve accuracy, relevance, and consistency of outputs for security and compliance use cases.
* Establish evaluation frameworks and QC processes (accuracy benchmarks, hallucination checks, bias/drift monitoring) to continuously assess and improve AI model and pipeline performance.
* Apply understanding of modern software development practices — version control, code review, testing — to build maintainable, production\-grade data and AI pipelines; CI/CD pipeline design and deployment automation.
* Support infrastructure management for data/AI systems (cloud resources, containerization, environment configuration) and contribute to CI/CD automation for reliable, scalable deployment of models and data pipelines.

**As a candidate, you must have:**

* A bachelor’s degree in information technology (IT), Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or equivalent military/professional training
* 3\-5 years of Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and Machine Learning experience
* Proficient in Python, SQL, querying databases, familiarity with analytics tools, and statistical techniques
* Skilled in developing data pipelines from diverse sources, including APIs and Structured Databases
* Strong expertise in data transformation, processing, and visualization
* Self\-motivated team player with the flexibility to work various shifts and deliver high\-quality results, and willing to assist the team with overtime as applicable
* Maintain required state guard card and client\-requested certifications; employee is responsible for documentation and fees.

**We offer:**

* $90,000 salary
* Health, Dental, Vision, and 401 (k)
* Paid Time Off, including Sick/Safe Time
* A dynamic and challenging work environment with opportunities for growth

**What is Verse?**



The race to AI has become the race to power. Every breakthrough in artificial intelligence depends on one thing: access to electricity. But across the country, aging grid infrastructure and years\-long interconnection queues are slowing the deployment of the data centers that will power the next generation of innovation. Solving this challenge isn't just about energy—it's about unlocking the future of AI.

Our software helps the world's largest energy consumers achieve faster, cheaper, and cleaner power by combining real\-time control of energy assets with complete visibility into their energy portfolio. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, Coatue, and NVIDIA, and built by pioneers in grid\-scale batteries, energy markets, and enterprise software, we're redefining how the world's most ambitious organizations access and manage energy.

The Human Services Agency (HSA) of County of San Mateo is seeking qualified **Child Welfare Program Analyst (Human Services Analyst II)** to join the Children and Family Services (C\&FS) Branch. The CWPA will report to the Children and Family Services Administrative and Program Support Services Manager and will support **Child Welfare System Strategies and Contracted Services**.


The Child Welfare Program Analyst (CWPA) provides analytical, administrative, and project support for programs within Children and Family Services. This position requires independent judgment, strong organizational and analytical skills, and ideally a general knowledge of child welfare programs and practices. The CWPA may be assigned lead responsibility for projects and initiatives and will work closely with program managers, internal teams, community partners, and other stakeholders.


**CWS\-CARES Go\-Live:** A key responsibility of this position will be serving as the lead analyst as part of the Organizational Change Management Team for **CWS\-CARES**, the new child welfare Statewide case management system, scheduled to go\-live December 7, 2026\. Responsibilities will include developing and maintaining business process maps and implementation resources; providing on\-site and over\-the\-shoulder support during and after go\-live; maintaining SharePoint content and resource repositories; preparing communications, reports, and other project materials; and providing ongoing implementation support while adapting to evolving project needs, priorities, and timelines.


**Program Support and Contracted Services:** In addition to supporting CWS\-CARES implementation, the CWPA will work with Program Managers to develop and maintain a variety of documents, including, but not limited to, scopes of work, request for proposals, written reports, data reports, performance metrics, and County forms. The CWPA will receive and process invoices and help facilitate related signature and tracking processes.


Additional responsibilities may include conducting research and providing information to support management recommendations; supporting the integration of key initiatives and C\&FS priorities; communicating with community organizations regarding program requirements; working closely with community\-based service providers to support program compliance and provide technical assistance; developing service agreements; reviewing and interpreting State guidance and policies; and performing other duties as assigned.


The ideal candidate is a collaborative, organized, proactive, and adaptable professional who enjoys working as part of a team and can effectively navigate a fast\-paced and evolving environment. The successful candidate will be comfortable taking initiative, identifying what needs to be done, and stepping in to support the team without always being asked.


The **ideal candidate** will demonstrate:


* **Analytical and problem\-solving skills:** Ability to analyze information, identify issues, develop practical solutions, and make sound recommendations.
* **Project management and organization:** Ability to coordinate projects, manage competing priorities and deadlines, and follow through on assignments.
* **Communication:** Ability to communicate clearly and professionally and prepare concise, accurate written materials.
* **Initiative and adaptability:** Takes ownership, anticipates needs, and adjusts effectively to changing priorities and project needs.
* **Collaboration:** Works effectively with staff, managers, community partners, service providers, and other stakeholders.
* **Program and process knowledge:** Experience supporting the development, implementation, and improvement of programs and processes; general knowledge of child welfare or social service programs and practices is desirable.
**Duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:**


* Develop grants and contracts with the State and other funding sources, including the negotiation of specific items in the agreement and budget preparation.
* Draft requests for proposals, evaluate proposals and negotiate contracts.
* Provide technical programmatic and fiscal assistance to staff and subcontractors, including the development of policies and procedures and the training of staff.
* Monitor and evaluate the performance of subcontractors, including budget analysis and field monitoring, to ensure conformance with performance goals and fiscal requirements.
* Develop and implement marketing and funding strategies and policies and procedures for assigned programs; develop and monitor budgets.
* Represent assigned programs and the Agency at various meetings and conferences and serve as the liaison with the state and other organizations.
* Analyze legislation and develop policy and procedures for implementation by staff and subcontractors.
* Provide work direction to support staff.
* Collect, analyze and interpret various information, develop recommendations and present findings.
* Write reports and grant proposals and make presentations to boards, committees and other groups.
* Coordinate and conduct special events and projects.
* Develop and maintain computer files and generate reports.
* Perform related duties as assigned.

**Note: This is a limited\-term, at\-will assignment. Limited term employees are assigned to assignments not to exceed three years. Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. It delivers self\-paced training that prepares professionals for licensure and continuing education, built around G.A.I.L. (Generative Artificial Intelligence Learning) \- an interactive tutor that gives real\-time feedback, personalized explanations and adaptive support, so someone studying on demand still gets guidance. The flagship course is a 40\-hour Wastewater Class 3 Operator Training recognized by the Georgia Secretary of State, alongside a 24\-hour continuing education course and an industrial wastewater program. Organizations can run a customized version, Powered by Slater Certified®, against their own workforce.


Slater Certified, LLC is the workforce development arm of Slater Infrastructure Group, LLC \- an Alpharetta, Georgia infrastructure services firm founded in 1997, working across operations and maintenance, construction engineering and inspection, and environmental services for public and private clients. Slater Certified launched in July 2025 and is licensed in Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia and Mississippi.


The team is small and moves fast. Technology choices are modern and made by the people who have to live with them, so the distance between an idea and a decision is short, and the distance between a decision and shipping it is shorter. Work is remote and the schedule is flexible. Ownership sits with the person doing the work, and there is real room to shape how things get built rather than inheriting someone else's process.


**Position summary**

Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. We are selling and building at the same time, with a small team and a lot of moving parts: prospects in conversation, clients being onboarded, courses in development, and commitments made in a sales meeting that engineering then has to deliver.


We are hiring a Project Manager on a contract basis to be the bridge between sales and delivery. You hold the single picture of where everything stands \- who is in the pipeline, who is in flight and how far along they are, what we can sell today, what is coming and when, and what each of those depends on. When sales asks whether we can commit to a date, you are the person who knows.


You will work directly with the VP of Sales, the CTBO and the engineering team, keeping logistics and pipeline moving. It is part project manager, part coordinator, part meeting facilitator \- hands\-on, no direct reports, and a lot of detail that nobody else is going to pick up. If it works on both sides, there is a path to converting it to a full\-time position.


**What this role owns in the first six months**

* One view of the pipeline and delivery that sales, engineering and leadership all use and all trust \- not three spreadsheets that disagree.
* The existing pipeline, built up so far by our business development lead, has been taken over and turned into something that runs as a system rather than living in one person's head.
* Every client in flight has a plan, a timeline, a named status and a next action, current enough that nobody has to ask.
* A standing, accurate answer to “what can we sell today, what is coming, and when” \- so sales stops guessing and engineering stops being surprised.
* Status reporting that leadership reads instead of requesting.
* Meetings that end with decisions and owners rather than another meeting.

**Key responsibilities**

**Bridging sales and delivery**


* Sit between the VP of Sales, the CTBO and engineering, and keep all three working from the same picture.
* Translate what sales is promising into what engineering has to build, and flag the gap before a commitment is made rather than after.
* Maintain what is sellable today versus what is on the roadmap, and keep that honest.
* Chase the dependencies between the two sides \- the content, the configuration, the approval, the answer from a customer \- so nothing stalls quietly.

**Pipeline and clients in flight**


* Take handover of the pipeline as it stands today from business development, and make it current, complete and usable by everyone who needs it.
* Track prospects through the pipeline: where each one stands, what it is waiting on, what it would take to close.
* Run onboarding for clients in flight end to end, from kickoff to go\-live.
* Keep the CRM and the delivery plan reflecting the same reality.
* Be the point of contact who knows the status, and who tells a client before they have to ask.

**Delivery with engineering**


* Own the Jira board: hygiene, flow, and whether it still describes how work actually moves.
* Turn requirements into tickets with clear scope and acceptance criteria, and push back when a requirement is not ready.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Broadcast Media
new_jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

A senior project manager (SPM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiation through Closing phases. However, the SPM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project managers role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders. The SPM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions on all Broadcast projects, budgets, and scopes. The SPM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities. Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for team participants, managing deliverables from the consulting team, and overseeing the completion of projects.
  
The SPM is responsible for completing consulting projects on time, on budget and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction from our customers. Most of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes. As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long\-term relationship. They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications, and satisfaction.
  
  

**Location:** Preferred Northeast or Southeast
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on\-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to Media and Entertainment’s consulting projects
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, internal and external consultants and subject matter experts, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members. Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Coordinates all deliverable documentation between all internal and external stakeholders. Facilitates and directs document reviews to assure proper documentation is delivered to the client. Provides punch\-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates transition of projects to later phase project teams.


**Complexity:**  

Every project is different, and project stakeholders are different. The SPM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between discovery, analysis, conceptual design, and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence, and people management skills. The SPM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality, and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.
  
  

**Decision Making Authority:**  

* Takes full ownership of project
* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.

--------------------


The BioWatch Project Manager (PM) oversees nationwide BioWatch laboratory staffing and operational support for the Department of Homeland Security’s Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office. This position serves as the contractor’s primary point of contact for DHS, ensuring high\-quality laboratory performance, staffing continuity, compliance with federal standards, and successful execution of mission\-critical biothreat detection operations. The PM leads distributed scientific teams and ensures BioWatch laboratories maintain 24/7 readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead and manage all contractor activities supporting BioWatch laboratory operations across multiple jurisdictions.
* Serve as the single point of contact for the DHS Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer’s Representative.
* Oversee daily performance, attendance, conduct, and quality compliance for all contractor lab personnel.
* Ensure staffing levels meet or exceed DHS requirements and coordinate timely recruitment, replacement, and onboarding.
* Support adherence to BioWatch standard operating procedures, quality assurance programs, and national security protocols.
* Coordinate with Technical Managers and Training Manager to resolve operational issues, implement corrective actions, and maintain training compliance.
* Provide monthly progress reports, annual performance updates, and regular briefings to DHS leadership.
* Ensure readiness for surge support, special events, and emergency deployments, including rapid mobilization of trained staff.

* Strong leadership skills managing dispersed scientific teams and complex operations.
* Ability to communicate effectively with federal, state, and local partners.

new_jobs.description:
Trade Show Project Manager

Job Summary

The Trade Show Project Manager is responsible for managing the planning, coordination, and execution of client trade show exhibit projects from kickoff through onsite delivery. This role serves as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, vendors, and show services to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.

Because tradeshow timelines, requirements, and client needs can evolve, this role requires sound judgment, prior tradeshow experience, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving to keep projects moving forward even when information is incomplete.

Working Style \& Expectations

* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven tradeshow environment, managing multiple projects with varying timelines
* Able to make informed decisions and move projects forward as details evolve
* Proactive communicator who anticipates issues, flags risks, and escalates appropriately
* Uses prior tradeshow experience and judgment to manage ambiguity and competing priorities
* Operates with a high level of autonomy, proactively identifying next steps without waiting for direction
* Comfortable managing 15–25 active projects at various stages
* Comfortable working with external vendors and holding partners accountable to deadlines and deliverables.
* Remote role in Pacific Standard Time

Key Responsibilities

Client \& Project Coordination

· Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients throughout the trade show project lifecycle

· Lead project kickoffs and gather required information to initiate trade show programs

· Guide clients through exhibitor order deadlines, show services, and required

documentation

· Maintain clear, proactive communication regarding timelines, deliverables, and next steps

· Own assigned tradeshow programs from kickoff through post\-show reconciliation, ensuring deadlines, budgets, and client expectations are met.

Tradeshow Logistics \& Show Services

· Coordinate all show\-related logistics, including:

o Shipping and material handling

o Installation and dismantle (I\&D) labor

o Electrical, rigging, internet, and other show services

· Complete and submit exhibitor service orders as needed

· Track show deadlines and ensure compliance with advance and standard pricing schedules

Production \& Internal Coordination

· Partner with external production and fabrication teams to keep projects on schedule

· Request and distribute artwork templates to clients

· Coordinate submission of approved artwork to production partners

· Track production milestones and flag risks or delays early

Project Management \& Documentation

· Manage multiple trade show projects simultaneously, maintaining accurate schedules and

task lists

· Maintain organized project files, documentation, and communication records

· Track outstanding action items and follow up with clients, vendors, and internal teams

· Provide onsite support for select tradeshows, including supervising installation, addressing issues, and supporting clients on the show floor

Qualifications

* 3–5 years of experience in tradeshow, exhibit, or event project coordination
* Working knowledge of tradeshow processes, show services, and exhibitor requirements
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple

deadlines

* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable working directly with clients, vendors, and cross\-functional partners
* Proficiency with project management tools (Basecamp), HubSpot, spreadsheets, and shared file systems
* Willingness to travel occasionally for trade shows

Preferred Experience

* Experience working in an exhibit house, experiential agency, or trade show services

environment

* Familiarity with I\&D labor coordination, shipping logistics, and production timelines
* Prior client\-facing project management or coordination experience

About Exhibit Potential

Exhibit Potential is a boutique, agency\-style exhibit and trade show services company that partners with clients to plan, manage, and deliver custom trade show programs. The team works closely with external fabricators, production partners, and show vendors to coordinate exhibit delivery, logistics, and onsite execution. This role focuses on project coordination and client management rather than on in\-house exhibit fabrication.

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

* Do you have experience working at a Trade Show Exhibit Company?
